v: Ay jun b'ab'el uum tz'ib'ab'ilxo b'at t'ayach wuuj, ach Teófilo. Hata' ix wala' jantak tas ix sk'ulej Jesús yet' tas ix yak' k'ayb'ajok, yiktax ix syamanoch sk'ayb'ani
masanto ix ja jun k'ual ayik ix pax t'a satcha'anh. Ayik manto paxi, ix yalankan juntzanh scheknab'il t'a heb' schekab', haton heb' sik'b'ilel yuj, icha ix ak'ji yal yuj Yespíritu Dios.

Ayik toxo ix ek' chamel t'a yib'anh, tzijtum elto ix sch'ox sb'a t'a heb' schekab' chi'. 40 k'ualto ix eq'ui, ixto sch'ox sb'a t'a heb' to yel ix pitzwixi. Ix yalankan t'a heb' to ol wach' och Dios Yajalil.
Ayik ayto ek' yet' heb' schekab' chi', ix yalan icha tik t'a heb': --Manh ex el t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén tik. Tanhwejek jun tas yalnakkan Dios t'ayex, icha wutejnak walan t'ayex.
Yel toni, a winhaj Juan ak'jinak bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta hato t'a yik jayexo k'u, ol ak'jok Yespíritu Dios t'ayex. Ichato ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj, xchi Jesús.
Ayik ayto ek' Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿am tiknaik ol a kolelta heb' ketchonhab' israel, yik munil skak'och junok yajal t'a ko kal junelxo? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Max ak'jilaj eyojtakejel sk'ual, ma stiempoal b'ak'uinh ol ujok, yujto a juntzanh chi', anhej Dios ko Mam ay yalan yik t'ay.

Palta ol yak' spoder Dios t'ayex, ayik ol ochkan Espíritu Santo t'ayex. Ol lajwok chi', haxo eyalanel wab'ixal t'a Jerusalén tik, t'a masanil yol yik Judea tik, t'a yol yik Samaria yet' t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix k'ex t'a satcha'anh. Q'uelank'e heb' t'ay ix satk'e t'a skal jun asun. Majxo yil-laj heb'.
Q'uelanto k'e heb' t'a satcha'anh chi' ayik wanto sk'ex Jesús, haxo ix yilan heb', ayxoek' chawanh ángel icha yilji anima t'a stz'ey heb', te sak spichul heb'.

Ix yalan heb': --Ex winak aj Galilea, ¿tas yuj hanheja' eyajk'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh? Ha Jesús, ix el t'a he kal, ix pax t'a satcha'anh, icha ix aj eyilan sk'ex tik, icha pax chi' ol aj yemxuli, xchi heb' ángel chi' t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' t'a tzalan Oliwo chi'. Ix b'atxi heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ha jun tzalan chi', ay am nanhalok legua skal yet' Jerusalén chi'.

Ixlajwi sk'och heb' t'a chonhab' chi', ix k'e heb' t'a jun kuarto chaanh yajk'ei. Haton b'aj ay sposado winhaj Pedro, winhaj Jacobo, winhaj Juan, winhaj Andrés, winhaj Felipe, winhaj Tomás, winhaj Bartolomé, winhaj Mateo, winhaj Jacobo yuninal winhaj Alfeo, winhaj Simón, haton winh yetb'eyumejnak sb'a yet' heb' Zelote yet' winhaj Judas yuninal winhaj Jacobo. Hata' ay sposado heb' winh smasanil.
Junjun k'u smolb'an sb'a heb' winh smasanil ta', yik slesalwi heb' winh t'a Dios yet' heb' winh yuk'tak Jesús, ix María ix snun Jesús chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix ix.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay am junok 120 heb' kreyente ix smolb'ej sb'a. Haxo winhaj Pedro ix k'e waan t'a skal heb'. Ix yalan winh:

--Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', yowalil ix elk'och icha tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios. Yujto a Yespíritu Dios ak'annak stz'ib'ejkan winhaj David yuj winhaj Judas, haton winh ch'oxjinak Jesús t'a heb' yamjinak.
Ha winhaj Judas chi', ketb'eyum ko b'a yet' winh t'a yalanhtaxo, junnhej kopisio yet' winh.
Palta a yet' k'een tumin ix scha winh t'a spatik jun chukal ix sk'ulej chi', a yet' k'een ix sman jun lum lum winh, ix kot pichnaj winh, ix elta usnaj yol sk'ool winh.
Ha heb' ay t'a Jerusalén tik, ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' ix yak' skuch jun lu'um chi' heb', Acéldama t'a sti' heb'. Syalelk'ochi: Lum Schiq'uil Anima.
Syal pax icha tik t'a jun libro Salmos: Kanokab' tzinan b'aj kajan winh. Manhxaokab' mach ol kajnaj t'ay, xchi. Syalanxi icha tik: Ch'okxookab' mach tz'ochpaxkan t'a yopisio, xchikani.

Yuj chi' ko sik'ekelta junok mach tz'och sk'exulok winh. Skak'anoch yopisio yalaneli to ix pitzwixi Jesús. Ha jun ol ko sik'elta chi', yowalil toxonton ketb'eyum ko b'a yet'ok ayik onh ek' yet' Kajal Jesús, yiktax yak'jinak bautizar heb' anima yuj winhaj Juan, masanto ix pax Jesús t'a satcha'anh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix naji t'a yib'anh chawanh heb' winh, haton winhaj José Barsabás, skuchan pax Justo yet' winhaj Matías.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi heb' smasanil. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, ojtak tas yaj ko pensar ko masanil. Yuj chi' ch'ox t'ayonh mach junok heb' chawanh tik tza sik'elta
yik wach' ol och yopisio schekab'ok Jesucristo. Yujto ix ik'jiel winhaj Judas t'a yopisio yuj smul. Ix b'at winh b'aj smoj sk'ochi, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' winh schawanhil. Yuj chi' ix cheklajelta to a winhaj Matías ix ochkan t'a yib'anh. Ha winh ix ochkan stz'akub'ok heb' winh uxluchwanh schekab' Jesucristo chi'.
Ayik ix ja sk'ual q'uinh Pentecostés, junnhej b'aj ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' kreyente smasanil.
Haxo t'a jun rato chi', ix k'anh jun t'a satcha'anh, icha sk'anh junok ik' te ow. Ix laj k'anh yek' t'a yol jun pat b'aj k'ojanem heb' chi'.
Ix yilan juntzanh tas heb' icha sk'e nhilnhon te' k'ak'. Ix pukaxb'at t'a skal heb'. Ix em t'a yib'anh junjun heb'.
Ix laj ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a junjun heb'. Ix och ijan heb' slolon t'a juntzanhxo ch'okch'ok tial, hato syala' tas ix ak'ji yal heb' yuj Espíritu Santo chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ayek' juntzanh heb' israel t'a Jerusalén chi', haton heb' skot t'a ch'okch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha t'a Dios syal sb'a heb'.
Ayik ix k'anh jun chi', tzijtum anima ix smolb'ej sb'a t'a jun pat chi'. Ix laj somchaj spensar heb', yujto ix laj yab'laj sti' heb', yujto a heb' kreyente syal sti' junjun chonhab' heb'.
Ix te sat sk'ool heb', ix laj och k'eljab' heb'. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha wal heb' wan slolon tik, aj Galilea heb' smasanil.
Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj skab' yalan ko ti' heb'? Palta ina ch'okch'ok ko ti' junjun onh.
Ha t'a ko kal tik ay heb' aj Parta. Ay heb' aj Media, ay heb' aj Elam, ay heb' aj Mesopotamia, ay heb' aj Judea, ay heb' aj Capadocia, ay heb' aj Ponto yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Asia.

Ay heb' aj Frigia, heb' aj Panfilia, heb' aj Egipto. Ay pax heb' aj Libia t'a yichanhb'at Cirene. Ay pax juntzanh heb' aj Roma, aytaxon ek' t'a tik. Ketisraelal nanhal heb'. Haxo nanhalxo heb' manh israeloklaj heb', palta ochnak heb' t'a ko k'ayb'ub'al.
Ay pax heb' aj Creta yet' heb' aj Arabia. Ko masanil skab' slolon heb' t'a ko ti' yik syalan heb' jantak wal tas satub'tak sb'o Dios, xchi heb'.
Ix laj sat sk'ool heb' smasanil, ix laj somchaj heb'. Ix laj yalan heb': --¿Tas wal yaj juntzanh tik? xchi heb'.
Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' jun, tonhej ix b'uchwaj heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Ha juntzanh heb' tik, uk'umanh heb', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj Pedro yet' heb' winh uxluchwanh yetchekab'wumal. Te chaanh ix yal winh t'a skal heb' anima chi': --Ex aj Judea yet' ex he masanil ayextaxonek' t'a Jerusalén tik, swak' eyojtakejel tas yaj jun tik. Hak'uekoch he chikin t'a tas ol wal t'ayex.
¿Tom tze na'a to uk'um onh anh? Maay, ina k'e k'ualto tiknaik.
Palta a winhaj Joel, winh schekab' Dios t'a peka', ayokto yalannakkan winh t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, xchi icha tik:

Ix yalan Dios: Ha t'a yik slajwub' k'ual, ol wak'och Wespíritu t'a masanil anima. Haxo heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyisil ol alanel in lolonel. Ha t'a heb' kelemtak ol in ch'ox juntzanh tas t'a wayichal. Haxo t'a heb' ichamtak winak, ol in lolon t'a heb' t'a swayich.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol wak'och Wespíritu t'a jantaknhej heb' tzin ak'an serwil, wach'chom winak, mato ix, ol yalel in lolonel heb'.

Ol in ch'oxan juntzanh tas t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, ol sat sk'ool heb' anima yilani. Ol in ch'oxpax juntzanhxo tas sch'oxanel in poder, haton chik', k'ak' yet' jun niwan tab' icha asun.

Ha k'u ol k'ik'b'okelok. Haxo k'een uj, te chak ol aj k'een icha chik'. Icha chi' ol ajok ayik manto ja sk'ual yowal in k'ool a in Yajal in tik. Ha jun k'ual chi', te niwan yelk'ochi. Ol te sat sk'ool heb' anima yuj.
Haxo heb' syal sb'a t'ayin a in Yajal in tik, ol laj kolchaj heb', xchi Dios t'a Slolonel chi'.

Ex wetisraelal, ak'ekoch he chikin t'a juntzanhxo ol wal tik t'ayex. Ha Dios ix ch'oxani chajtil yopisio Jesús aj Nazaret t'ayex, ayik ix sb'oan juntzanh milagro, juntzanh malaj b'aj skila' yet' juntzanhxo tas sch'oxanel spoder. Ha juntzanh chi' ix sb'o Dios yet' Jesús. Ina eyojtaktaxon juntzanh tik.

Palta a Jesús chi', ix ak'jikanoch t'a yol he k'ab', yujto icha chi' ix el t'a sk'ool Dios. Yiktax t'a pekataxo yojtakxo Dios tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh Jesús chi'. Ha ex tik ix he majnej sk'ab' heb' chuk, yik ix eyamani, ix he kulusank'ei. Icha chi' ix eyutej he milanchamok.
Palta haxo Dios ix ak'an pitzwokxi. Ix yak'an ganar spitzwixi, yujto a chamel malaj tz'och t'ay.
Ha winhaj David alannakkan yab'ixal Jesús chi' to ol pitzwokxi. Xchi icha tik: Masanil tiempo naan achnhej wuuj. Yujto ayachek' t'a in wach' k'ab', yuj chi' max somchajel-laj in k'ool.
Yuj chi' ste tzalaj in k'ool, tzin b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal. Malaj tas tzin na yuj in niwanil tik, yujto tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Yujto manh ol aktejkanlaj in pixan t'a skal heb' chamnak, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in ton tik sik'b'il in el uuj.
Ix ak' wojtakejel sb'eal k 'inal, ol ak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool ayik ayachek' wet'ok. Icha chi' yaj stz'ib'ankan winhaj David t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ex wetchonhab', te chekel tas ajnak winh ko mam kicham aj David chi'. Kojtak to chamnak winh, muknajnak winh. Ha jun yet'tal b'aj mukan winh chi', hanheja' chekelto yajek' tiknaik.
Palta a winhaj David chi', ak'b'il yopisio winh yalankani tastak ol jawok. Yojtak winh to te yel sti' Dios yak'nakkan t'ay, to a Cristo ol elixkan yinhtilok, haxo yochkan reyal chi' sk'exulok winh.

Ayokto ix yojtakanel winhaj David chi' tas ol aj Cristo. Yuj chi' yalnakkan winh to ol pitzwokxi Cristo chi'. Ix yalanpaxkan winh to ha Dios manh ol aktankan spixan t'a skal heb' chamnak. Haxo sniwanil, manh ol k'aok.
Yuj chi' a Jesús tik, ha Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok. Ko masanil skak'och ko b'a testigoal yuj jun tik, yujto ix kila'.

Hanhejtona', ix pax t'a satcha'anh yuj spoder Dios, yik b'at em k'ojan t'a swach' k'ab' Dios chi', haxo ix ak'an Espíritu Santo t'ay, icha yutejnak yalankani. Haxo Jesús chi' ix ak'ankot jun tzeyil tik yet' jun tzeyab' tik.
Ha winhaj David chi' maj b'atlaj winh t'a satcha'anh yet' sniwanil. Palta yalnakkan winh icha tik: Ha Dios Kajal alannak t'a Wajalil: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab',
masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'ool t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Dios t'a Wajalil, xchi winhaj David chi'.

Palta in gana tzeyojtakejel sik'lab'il he masanil ex wetisraelal to a Jesús ix he kulusejk'e chi', haton ix ak'jioch Kajalok yuj Dios. Ix ak'jioch Cristoal, haton jun tanhwab'iltaxon sjawi kuuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' chonhab', ix te och pitz'an kusk'olal t'a spixan heb'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a winhaj Pedro yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' schekab' Jesús: --Ex wetanimail, ¿tas wach' ko k'ulan tiknaik jun? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb': --Naek he b'a. Hak'ek bautizar he b'a t'a sb'i Jesucristo, yik wach' ol ak'jok lajwok he mul yuj Dios. Ichato chi', ol yak'an Espíritu Santo t'ayex.

Yujto icha chi' ajnak yak'annakkan sti' t'ayonh, t'a heb' kuninal yet' pax t'a masanil mach najat ay. Yujto a Kajalil ko Diosal syak' Yespíritu t'a jantaknhej heb' syawtejkot yikok, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Tzijtumto tas ix yal winh t'a heb'. Ix yak'anpax razón winh t'a heb': --Ik'ekel he b'a t'a skal heb' malaj swach'il tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ay heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool tas ix yal winhaj Pedro chi'. Ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a heb'. Ha heb' ix och kreyenteal t'a jun k'u chi', ay am oxeok mil heb'.

Ix yak'an wal och spensar heb' t'a juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al ix yal heb' schekab' Jesús chi'. Junxonhej ix yutej spensar heb' smasanil. Slesalwi heb', smolb'an sb'a heb', swaan ixim pan heb' yik wach' snaankot Jesús Kajal heb'.
Ha heb' schekab' Jesús, tzijtum milagro ix sch'ox heb' yuj spoder Dios. Yuj chi' ix laj xiw heb' anima smasanil.
Jantaknhej heb' ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool, junxonhej ix aj heb'. Jantaknhej tastak ay t'a heb', junxonhej ix laj yutej heb'.
Ay heb' ix laj schonhel sluum yet' jantaknhej tastak ay t'a heb'. Ix laj spukanek' stojol heb' t'a skal, icha syala' tastak tz'och yuj junjun heb'.
Junjun k'u smolb'an sb'a heb' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Haxo t'a spat heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik smol wa heb'. Junxonhej slaj wa heb' t'a tzalajk'olal. Te junk'olal ix aj heb'.
Slaj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios, ste tzalaj pax heb' anima smasanil yet' heb'. Haxo Jesús Kajal tz'ak'an q'uib' sb'isul heb' t'a junjun k'u, yuj heb' wan skolchaj chi' yuj.
Ha junel, t'a a las tres yik yemk'ualil, molan ix b'at winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a stemplo Dios, yujto icha chi' yorail slesalwi heb' aj Israel ta'.

Ay jun winh, junjun k'u tzul chelchajkan t'a yol sti' jun spuertail yamaq'uil templo chi', haton t'a jun skuch Wach' Yilji, yik sk'an tumin winh t'a heb' sk'och t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi', yujto max yal sb'ey winh yiktax ix alji.
Haxo ix yilan winh sk'och winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a stemplo Dios chi', ayik wan yoch heb' winh ta', ix sk'anan stumin winh t'a heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' ix och k'elan t'a winh. --Kotanh k'elan t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix och k'elan winh t'a heb' winh. Ha snaan winh to ol ak'jok jab'ok stumin winh yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh: --Ha in tik, malaj in tumin. Palta ay jun syal wuuj, a yet' jun chi' ol in kolwaj t'ayach. Yuj spoder Jesucristo aj Nazaret k'eanh waan, b'eyanh, xchi winh t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi' ix yaman sk'ab' winh t'a swach'. Ix sketzank'e waan winh. Elanhchamel ix och yip yok winh yet' yip sjaj yok winh schab'il.
Ix k'e juknaj winh, ix och ijan winh sb'eyi. Ix och winh t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi' yet' heb' winh, sk'e chennaj winh ayik sb'eyek' winh. Ix yalanpax wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix laj yil heb' sb'eyek' winh, ix yab'an heb' yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios.
Yuj chi' ix te sat sk'ool heb' yuj tas ix aj sb'o winh, yujto yojtak heb' to junjun k'u k'ojanem winh sk'an tumin t'a sti' spuertail yamaq'uil templo chi', haton t'a jun skuch Wach' Yilji.

Ha winh ix b'oxi yok chi', junnhej tzek' winh yet' winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi'. Haxo heb' anima smasanil, ix te sat sk'ool heb'. Yuj chi' ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil t'a stz'ey heb' winh ayik ayek' heb' winh t'a jun stentail stemplo Dios skuchan Yik Salomón.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Pedro chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetisraelal, ¿tas yuj ste sat he k'ool onh eyilani? ¿Tas yuj tzex och k'elan t'ayonh? Manh he na'a to yuj ko jelanil mato yuj ko wach'il ix b'oxi sb'ey jun winh tik.

Ha ko Diosal, hanheja' jun Dios b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Yuj paxi te niwan ix aj yelk'och Jesús, haton Yuninal. Palta a ex tik, ix eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal. Ha winh yajal skuchan Pilato, snib'ej winh ix yak'el t'a libre. Ha exxo maj yal-laj he k'ool.
Ha Jesús chi', yiknhej Dios yaji, te tojol sb'eyb'al. Palta a exxo tik, maj he cha el-laj t'a libre. Haxo jun winh mak'umcham anima ix he k'anelta sk'exulok.
Icha chi' ix eyutej he milancham jun aj k 'inal. Palta ha Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak. Ha jun tik skak' wal och ko b'a testigoal yuj.

Ha jun winh tzeyil tik, eyojtak winh, toxonton max yal sb'ey winh. Palta a Jesús ix ak'an b'oxok winh. Yujnhej to skak'och Jesús chi' t'a ko k'ool ix b'oxi sk'ool winh sik'lab'il t'a eyichanh he masanil.
Haxo tiknaik ex wetchonhab', wojtak to ix eyak' miljokcham Jesús chi' yujto manh eyojtakok tas wan he k'ulani. Icha pax chi' heb' yajal, manh yojtakok heb'.
Palta icha chi' ix yutej Dios yak'an elk'och tas alb'ilkan yuj heb' schekab'. Yujto yalnakkan heb' to a Cristo yowalil ol yab' syail.
Yuj chi', naek he b'a. Q'uexek he b'eyb'al, aq'ek och he pensar t'a Dios, yik wach' ol sukchaj sat he mul. Tato icha chi', ay jun pekti' ol yak' Dios Kajal tzalajk'olal t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik.
Ha Dios ol chekanxikot Jesús t'a schaelal, yujto a ak'jinak yopisio yoch Cristoal t'ayex yet' t'ayonh.

Palta a tiknaik, yowalil ol kannhej Jesucristo t'a satcha'anh, masanto ol jawok jun pekti' ayik ol b'o yaj masanil tas yuj Dios. Icha chi' yutejnak yalankanel t'a sti' heb' schekab' t'a peka', haton heb' yiknhej Dios yaji.

Haxo winhaj Moisés alannakkan icha tik t'a heb' ko mam kicham: Ha Dios Kajal ol sik'anelta jun schekab' t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', icha ix yutej in sik'anelta a in tik. Tzeyak' wal och he chikin t'a jantaknhej tas ol yal t'ayex.
Yujto a mach manh ol ak'anoch schikin smaklan yab' tas ol yala', ol satxikanel t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', xchinakkan Moisés chi' t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Ha jantaknhej heb' schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka', yiktax yek'nak winhaj Samuel, ix laj yalkan yab'ixal jun pekti' wan yek' tik heb'.

Palta a ex tik, yinhtil ex kan heb' winh alannakkanel slolonel Dios chi' ket'ok. Yuj chi', ayik yak'annakpaxkan strato Dios yet' heb' ko mam kicham chi', yak'nakpaxkan t'ayonh yet' heb'. Haton jun strato tik yak'nakkan t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Xchi icha tik: Yuj inhtilal, ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ayik ix yak'anxi pitzwok Yuninal, a t'ayonh ix sb'ab'laj chekejkoti, yik wach' tzonh kolchaji, skaktankan ko chukal junjun onh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Ayik wan yalan winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a heb' anima, ix k'och heb' winh sakerdote, winh yajalil heb' stanhwumal stemplo Dios yet' heb' winh sadukeo.
Ix kot yowal heb' winh, yujto a winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi', wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh. Wan yalan heb' winh to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, yujto icha chi' ix aj spitzwixi Jesús.
Yuj chi' ix yamji heb' winh yuj heb' winh, ix ak'jioch heb' winh t'a preso. Yujto yemxo k'ualil, yuj chi' jun ak'wal ix ochkan heb' winh.
Palta a wal heb' ix ab'an slolonel Dios t'a skal heb' anima chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb' kreyente. Ha sb'isul heb' winh winak, ay am oyeok mil.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh sat yajal t'a Jerusalén chi', heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yet' heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés.
Ajun winhaj Anás, winh sat sakerdote ix k'ochpax yet' heb' winh, hanhejtona' ix k'ochpax winhaj Caifás, winhaj Juan yet' winhaj Alejandro yet' jantaknhej heb' sk'ab' yok heb' winh sat sakerdote.

Ix b'at yak'an ik'jokkot winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a yichanh heb' winh. Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a heb' winh: --¿B'ajtil ix eyik' jun eyopisio tik yik tze k'ulan juntzanh tik? ¿Mach tz'ak'an he k'ulok? xchi heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', te ayoch Yespíritu Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: --Ex yajal eyaj t'a heb' chonhab' yet' ex yichamtak winakil israel,
tze k'anb'ej t'ayonh, yujto ay jun wach'il ix kak' t'a jun winh max yaltaxon sb'ey tik, tekan he gana tzeyab'i tas ix aj sb'oxi winh.

Yuj chi' a jun tik ol kal t'ayex, yik ol yojtakejel heb' ketisraelal smasanil. Ha winh ix jawi t'a eyichanh tik, ix b'oxi winh yujnhej spoder Jesucristo aj Nazaret, haton jun ix he kulusejk'ei. Palta haxo Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Ha ex tik, icha junok b'oum pat, icha chi' eyaji. Haxo Jesús, icha k'een k'een alb'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani to malaj tz'och t'ayex. Palta haxo ix och yopisio, icha k'een k'een ix och sjolomok chikin pat.
Malaj junokxo mach syal onh skolani, yujto ha t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj junokxo mach ix ak'ji yopisio yuj Dios yak'an ko kolnab'il, anhej wal Jesús, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Haxo ix yilan heb' winh yajal chi' to ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Pedro chi' yet' winhaj Juan yalani. Ix yilanpax heb' winh to manh k'ayb'ab'ilok heb' winh, komon anima heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix te sat sk'ool heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj heb' winh to junnhej ek'nak heb' winh yet' Jesús.
Ix yilanpax heb' winh to linhanoch winh ix b'oxi yok chi' t'a stz'ey heb' winh. Yuj chi' maj yal yak'anoch junok tas heb' winh t'a yib'anh heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' winh to tz'ik'jiel winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh, yakb'an slolon kan heb' winh sch'okoj.

Ixnhej elta heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas wal skutej heb' winh schawanhil tze na'a? Yujto yojtaknhej heb' aj Jerusalén tik to ix sb'o jun niwan milagro heb' winh. Yuj chi' max yal kalani to es.
Haxo tiknaik, yik max spukel jun ab'ix tik heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima, ko xib'tejek heb' winh, yik wach' manhxo ol yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo heb' winh t'a junokxo anima, xchi heb' winh yajal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtanxioch heb' winh heb' winh. Ix yalan wal heb' winh t'a heb' winh to manhxa b'ak'uinh syalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh, manhxa pax b'ak'uinh sk'ayb'ej heb' anima heb' winh t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al chi'.

Palta haxo ix tak'wi winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Scham wal he naani. ¿Tom wach' t'a sat Dios tze na'a, tato a eyik chi' sko k'anab'ajej, haxo Dios max ko k'anab'ajej tas syala'?
Yuj chi', max yal kaktan kalanel yab'ixal tas ix kila' yet' tas ix kab'i, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ix wach' xib'taj heb' winh yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'jiel heb' winh t'a libre. Max nachaj yuj heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh yak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Yujto masanil heb' chonhab' wan yalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios yuj jun ix sk'ulej heb' winh chi'.
Ha winh ix b'oxi yok chi', másxo 40 ab'il sk'inal winh.

Ixlajwi yak'jiel winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' t'a libre, ix b'at heb' winh. Ix k'ochxi heb' winh b'aj aykan juntzanhxo heb' yetb'eyum. Ix laj yalan heb' winh jantak tas ix yal heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio.

Haxo ix yab'an heb' yetb'eyum heb' winh chi', junnhej molanh ix aj slesalwi heb' t'a Dios. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, ach ko Diosal, a ach a b'onak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, ha' mar yet' smasanil tastak.

Ha ach lolonnak ach yet' Espíritu t'a jun a chekab' skuch David ayik yalannakkan icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj tz'el wek'ek'ok yaw heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sk'echaanh? ¿Tas wal yuj slajtiej sb'a heb' t'a junok tas manh ol tzak'wan heb' sb'oani?

Ha heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh yajal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', schichonoch sk'ool heb' winh, smolb'an sb'a heb' winh, junlajanxonhej syutej slajtian sb'a heb' winh t'a spatik winh Yajal yet' t'a spatik winh rey sik'b'ilel uuj, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

T'a wal yel, a winhaj Herodes, winhaj Poncio Pilato, heb' manh israelok yet' pax heb' israel, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik. Ix slajtian sb'a heb' t'a spatik Uninal, haton jun sik'b'ilelta uuj, haton jun ak'b'ilkan yopisio uuj.
Ix laj sb'o heb' jantaknhej tas alb'ilkan uuj t'a peka', yujto elnakxo t'a a k'ool to icha chi' sk'ulej heb'.
Haxo tiknaik Mamin, ina wal heb' tik, ste kot yowal heb' t'ayonh. Yuj chi', ak' ko tek'anil yik max onh xiw kalanel a lolonel, yujto a chekab' onh.
Ak' wal a poder t'ayonh, yik wach' ol b'oxok sk'ool heb' penaay. Ak' ko b'o juntzanh milagro sch'oxanel a poder, yujnhej Uninal haton Jesús, sik'b'ilkaneli, xchi heb' t'a Dios.

Ayik ix lajwi slesalwi heb' chi', haxo jun pat b'aj ayek' heb' chi' ix te tzikub'tanhaj yuj Dios. Ix te och wal Yespíritu Dios yet' heb' smasanil. Yuj chi' ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' yalanel slolonel Dios chi'.

Jantaknhej heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool, jun lajannhej ix yutej spensar heb'. Junk'olalxonhej ix aj heb'. Malaj junok mach ix halan yikok junok tas sch'okoj. Yujto a jantaknhej tas ay t'a heb', junnhej ix yutej heb' smasanil.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús ix tek'b'an sb'a yalaneli to ix pitzwixi Kajal Jesús chi'. Haxo Dios ix och yet' heb' kreyente smasanil.
Malaj junok mach meb'a' ix ajkan t'a skal heb', yujto a jantaknhej heb' ay sluum ma spat, ix laj schonhel heb'. Haxo stojol ix yik'kot heb'.
Ix yak'anoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' schekab' Jesús chi'. Haxo heb' ix pukanb'at t'a heb' kreyente chi', hato syala' tas tz'och yuj junjun heb'.
Ay jun winh kreyente skuch José, ix ak'ji skuch Bernabé yuj heb' schekab' Jesús. Ha Bernabé syalelk'ochi, Ak'umoch Tek'anil. Ha winh chi' yinhtilalkan Leví winh, aj chonhab' Chipre winh.
Ay jun sluum winh ix schonheli. Ix yik'ankot stojol winh, ix ul yak'ankan winh t'a heb' schekab' Jesús.
Ay jun winh skuchan Ananías, haxo ix yetb'eyum winh Safira sb'i ix. Ay jun sluum winh ix schonheli.

Ix schaan stojol jun sluum winh chi', palta ix yik'kanel nanhal yik winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi', yuj chi' manh tz'akanok stojol ayik xit' yak'ankan winh t'a heb' schekab' Jesús. Palta haxo ix aj yalan winh to tz'akan k'een tumin chi' smasanil. Yojtak pax ix yetb'eyum winh to icha chi' yaji.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Pedro t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj ix yak' a k'ool winh Satanás, yuj chi' tzesej t'a Yespíritu Dios? Ina ix ik'kanel nanhal k'een ik t'a stojol jun a lu'um chi'.

Ayik manto a chonh lu'um, yel ik lu'um. Hanhejtona' icha pax chi', ayik ix a chonhaneli, yel ik ton stojol chi'. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj ix a na jun chukal tik? Manhoklaj t'a heb' anima tzesej, palta a t'a Dios tzesej, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Ix lajwinhej yab'an jun chi' winhaj Ananías chi', ix ek' telnaj winh, ix cham winh. Haxo heb' ix ab'an spekal jun chi', ix te xiw heb'.
Haxo juntzanh heb' kelemtak ix jawi, ix sb'ak'anoch jun k'apak heb' t'a sniwanil winh. Ix yik'anelta winh heb', ix b'at smukankan winh heb'.
Ayxom oxeok hora scham winhaj Ananías chi', ix k'och ix yetb'eyum winh. Ix och ix t'a yol pat. Manh yojtakok ix tato ay tas ix ik'an winh yetb'eyum ix chi'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro ix k'anb'an t'a ix: --Al t'ayin, ¿tom yel to icha tik ix he chonhb'at jun he lu'um chi'? xchi winh t'a ix. --I', ichaton chi', xchi ix t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a ix: --¿Tas yuj tze mol lajtiej he b'a yik tzeyak'an prowal Yespíritu Dios Kajal? Ina yajek' heb' winh ix xit' mukankan winh etb'eyum t'a ti' pat chi'. Haxo tiknaik ol ach yik'paxb'at heb' winh a ach tik, xchi winh t'a ix.

T'a jun rato chi', ix telwi ix t'a yichanh winhaj Pedro chi'. Ix cham ix. Haxo ix ochk'och heb' kelemtak chi', ix yilan heb' chamnakxo pax ix. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at ix heb'. Ix b'at smukanem ix heb' t'a stz'ey winh yetb'eyum chi'.
Yuj chi' ix xiwk'e heb' kreyente smasanil yet' jantaknhej heb' ix ab'an spekal jun chi'.

Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús chi', tzijtum milagro ix sb'o heb'. Ix sch'ox wal el spoder Dios heb' t'a skal heb' anima. Ha t'a jun stentail stemplo Dios skuchan yik Salomón, hata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' kreyente smasanil.
Haxo heb' manh kreyenteok, malaj heb' stek'b'ej sb'a sk'ochi yik smolb'an sb'a heb' yet' heb'. Palta yojtak heb' to te wach' heb' kreyente chi'.
Tzijtum heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'ool.

Tz'ik'jipaxelta heb' penaay t'a yoltak kalle. Ay heb' tz'ik'jielta t'a sat ch'at, ay heb' t'a sat swaynub'. Hata' ix stanhwej heb' yek' winhaj Pedro, yik tope tzek' jab'ok yenhul winh t'a yib'anh heb' snaani.
Tzijtum heb' anima ix kot t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén. Ix yik'ankot juntzanh heb' penaay heb' yet' heb' tz'ixtax yuj heb' enemigo. Ix laj b'oxikan sk'ool heb' smasanil.
Haxo winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' yetb'eyum smasanil, haton heb' spartido heb' sadukeo, ix te och chichonk'olal t'a spixan heb'.
Yuj chi' ix schek yamjok heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' heb'. Ix ak'jioch heb' winh t'a jun preso yik heb' chonhab'.
Haxo t'ak'walil ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix ul jakan te' preso chi'. Ix ik'jielta heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' winh:
--Ixikek t'a stemplo Dios. Tzex och t'a yol yamaq'uil. Tzex aj linhan ta', tzeyalanel wach' ab'ix yik k 'inal t'a junelnhej, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' toxo wan sakb'i ayik ix ochk'och heb' winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios chi', ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh ta'. Haxo winh sat sakerdote chi' yet' heb' winh yetb'eyum ix awtankot heb' winh sat yajal, haton jantaknhej heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' israel. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' winh polenkía heb', yik sb'at heb' winh yik'elta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a preso.
Haxo ix k'och heb' winh t'a te' preso chi', manhxalaj mach ayeq'ui. Ixlajwi yilan heb' winh to manhxalaj mach, ix b'at yalan heb' winh icha tik:
--Ix kila', wach' yajoch sk'ab' te' preso chi'. Haxo heb' stanhwumal te' chi', linhanek' heb' t'a sti' te'. Palta haxo ix ko jakan te', ix kilani manhxalaj mach ayek' t'a yol te', xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winh sat sakerdote chi', heb' yetb'eyum yet' pax winh yajal heb' winh stanhwumal stemplo Dios, ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix te sat sk'ool heb' winh. Maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh tas wal yaji.

Junanto rato chi' ix k'och junxo winh. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha heb' winh ix eyak'och t'a preso, ayxo ek' heb' winh t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios tiknaik. Wan sk'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', haxo winh yajal heb' stanhwan templo chi' yet' heb' winh polenkía, ix b'at heb' winh yik'kot heb' winh. Palta ak'ank'olal ix yutej heb' winh yik'ankot heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi', yujto ix xiw heb' winh sjulk'enaj yuj heb' anima.
Ix b'at ak'ji heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal. Haxo winh sat sakerdote chi' ix halan t'a heb' winh.

--Ina ix cham wal kalan t'ayex to maxtzak he k'ayb'ej heb' anima t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jesús. ¿Tom max he k'anab'ajej? Ha tiknaik, ix te pukaxb'at he k'ayb'ub'al t'a Jerusalén tik, masanto he gana tze ch'oxelta to a onh ix ko milcham Jesús chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Pedro yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh schekab' Jesús, ix yalan heb' winh: --Yowalil a tas syal Dios, a sko k'anab'ajej. Haxo juntzanh scheknab'il anima, tato max scha sb'a yet' yik Dios, max ko k'anab'ajejlaj.

Ha ex tik ix eyak' miljokcham Jesús, ayik ix t'unhb'ajk'e t'a te' kulus. Palta a jun Dios b'aj yak'nak em sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, hanheja' ko Diosal a onh tik. A' ix ak'an pitzwokxi Jesús chi' t'a skal heb' chamnak.
Ha ix ak'an yopisio, ix yik'anb'at t'a swach'k'ab'. Ix yak'anoch Kajalok yet' ko Kolumalok, yik wach' sko na ko b'a a onh israel onh tik, yik slajwikan ko mul yuj.

Ha onh tik, skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj juntzanh skal tik t'ayex. Hanhejtona' Yespíritu Dios syak' pax testigoal sb'a ket'ok. Ha Dios tz'ak'an Yespíritu tik t'a jantaknhej mach sk'anab'ajan tas syala', xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh yajal chi', ix te kot yowal heb' winh. Ix snib'ej heb' winh smilcham heb' winh t'a elanhchamel.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' winh yajal chi' ay jun winh fariseo skuch Gamaliel ayeq'ui. Te k'ayb'um winh t'a sley Dios. B'inajnak winh t'a wach'il yuj heb' anima. Ix k'e linhan winh. Ix schekan winh ik'jokkanelta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' junok rato.
Ixlajwi yelkankot heb' winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ex wetisraelal, naek wal sik'lab'il tas tzeyutej he b'oan yaj juntzanh heb' winh tik.

Ko naekkot jun winh skuch Teudas ek'nak t'a yalanhtaxo. Yak'nakoch sb'a winh yajalil t'a skal heb' anima. Yalannakel winh to te ay yopisio winh. Ay am junok chanhe' kiento winak ochnak yet' winh. Palta miljicham winh. Haxo jantak heb' ochnak yet' winh chi', saklemnakkanb'at heb'. Satnakpaxkanem jun yik heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun winh skuch Judas aj Galilea, yak'nakoch sb'a winh yak'an owal yet' heb' winh yajal ayik ix ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' anima. Tzijtum anima ochnak yet' winh. Hanheja' ix miljipaxcham junxo winh chi'. Haxo jantaknhej heb' ochnak yet' winh, saklemnakpaxkanb'at heb'.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, kaktejek kixtan heb' winh schekab' Jesús tik, yil heb' winh. Ha jun yik heb' winh tik, tato anhej heb' anima ay yiko', munil ol satxikanemok.
Palta tato ha Dios ay yiko', manh ol yal-laj kak'an lajwok. Ay smay to wan kak'an owal yet' Dios chi', xchi winh.

Ix snaan heb' winh yajal chi' to te yel syal winh. Yuj chi' ix awtajxioch heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' yuj heb' winh. Ix yalan heb' winh to smak'ji heb' winh. Ix yalanpax heb' winh t'a heb' winh to maxtzak yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix aktajel heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix elta heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal. Te wach' ix yab' heb' winh, yujto yujnhej Jesús ix yab' syail heb' winh icha snib'ej Dios.
Masanil k'u ix yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh to Cristo toni, syalelk'ochi Jun Sik'b'ilel yuj Dios. Ix laj ek' yalel heb' winh t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yet' t'a kaltak pat.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb' kreyente. Palta a heb' kreyente aj Grecia, ix kot yowal heb' t'a heb' kreyente aj Israel, yujto ayik tz'ak'ji wa heb' meb'a' t'a junjun k'u, manh tz'akanok tz'ak'ji swael heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum aj Grecia chi'.
Yuj chi' ix awtajkot heb' kreyente smasanil yuj heb' schekab' Jesús chi'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh smojok skaktejkan kalanel slolonel Dios tik yik haxonhej wael tik skila'.

Yuj chi', ex wuk'tak, tze say ukwanhok winak t'a ko kal tik, tzeyak'anoch yopisio heb' sb'oan jun munlajel tik. Ha heb' tze say chi', haton heb' te wach' sb'eyb'al, heb' snachaj wal el yik Dios yuj, heb' te ay wal och Yespíritu Dios yet'ok.
Ha onhxo tik, hanheja' ol onh lesalwok, ol kalanpaxel slolonel Dios, xchi heb' lajchawanh chi'.

Ix te tzalaj heb' smasanil yuj jun lolonel chi'. Haxo heb' winh ix sik'jiel chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Esteban, te ay wal och spensar winh t'a Dios, te ay wal och Yespíritu Dios yet' winh, winhaj Felipe, winhaj Prócoro, winhaj Nicanor, winhaj Timón, winhaj Parmenas yet' winhaj Nicolás aj Antioquía. Ha winhaj Nicolás tik, ochnak winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ixlajwi sik'jielta heb' winh chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh schekab' Jesús. Haxo heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi' ix lesalwi yuj heb' winh, ix yak'anpaxek' sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sjolom heb' winh.
Haxo slolonel Dios ix te pukaxb'at t'a skal heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb' kreyente t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh sakerdote ix ak'anoch Cristo t'a sk'ool.
Haxo winhaj Esteban chi', niwan swach'k'olal Dios ix scha winh. Ix och wal Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' tzijtum milagro ix sch'oxel winh t'a skal heb' anima.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' israel smolb'ej sb'a t'a jun spatil kulto skuch Yik heb' Ak'b'ilxokanel t'a Libre. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' aj chonhab' Cirene, heb' aj Alejandría, heb' aj Cilicia yet' heb' aj Asia. Ix k'och heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi'. Ix stelan sb'a heb' yet' winh.
Palta maj yak'laj ganar winh heb', yujto a Espíritu Santo ix ak'an sjelanil winh.

Haxo heb' chi', tonhej ix sman jaywanh stestigo heb'. Ix ak'ji sk'ool heb' yuj heb', yik syal heb' icha tik: --Ix kab' sb'uchwaj winhaj Esteban tik t'a spatik winh ko mam kicham aj Moisés yet' t'a Dios, xchi heb'.

Icha chi' ix yutej heb' stzuntzan chaanh heb' chonhab', heb' ichamtak winak yet' heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés. Yuj chi' ix kot juknaj heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi', ix syaman winh heb', xit' yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix manji juntzanhxo heb' tz'ak'anoch es t'a yib'anh winhaj Esteban chi' yuj heb'. Ix stz'akan yal heb' icha tik t'a heb' winh yajal chi': --Ha winhaj Esteban tik, max yaktejkan winh sb'uchwaj t'a jun templo yiknhej Dios yaj tik. Sb'uchwaj pax winh t'a ley Moisés.
Ix kab' yalan winh icha tik: Ha Jesús aj Nazaret ol pojanem stemplo Dios tik. Ol k'exchaj juntzanh ko b'eyb'al ak'b'ilkan t'ayonh yuj Moisés chi', xchi winh, xchi heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yajal chi' yet' heb' k'ojanem ta' smasanil, ix och k'elan heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi', ix yilanoch sat winh heb', lajan yilji icha sat junok ángel.
Haxo winh sat sakerdote ix k'anb'an t'a winhaj Esteban chi': --¿Yel am juntzanh ix yal heb' tik? xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yal winhaj Esteban chi' icha tik: --Ex wetchonhab' yet' ex ichamtak winak, ab'ek nab'i. Ha Dios, te niwan yelk'ochi. Sch'oxnak sb'a t'a winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham ayik ayek' winh t'a yol yik Mesopotamia, ayik manto k'och kajan winh t'a chonhab' Harán.
Yalannak Dios chi' icha tik t'a winh: Aktejkan lum a lu'um tik yet' jantak heb' a k'ab' ok. Ixik t'a junxo lugar ol in ch'ox t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Slajwi chi', yaktannakkan slugar heb' kaldeo winh b'aj ayek' chi'. Haxo t'a chonhab' Harán k'ochnakkan kajan winh. Haxo yik schamnak winh smam winh, yik'jinakkot winh yuj Dios t'a jun lugar b'aj ay onh ek' tik.

Palta malaj jab'ok lu'um yak'nak Dios chi' yikok winh t'a tik. Malaj jab'ok ak'jinak t'a winh, palta yak'nakkan sti' Dios chi' t'a winh, ayik yalannakkan icha tik: Ol wak' jun a lu'um. Haxo yik ol ach chamok, ol kan jun a lu'um chi' yikok heb' inhtilal, xchi Dios chi' t'a winh. Ayik mantalaj junok yuninal winh, hata' yalnakkan jun chi' Dios.

Yalannakpaxkan Dios chi' icha tik t'a winh: Ha heb' inhtilal ol k'och kajan heb' t'a yol yik junxo ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol ak'jok och heb' schekab'ok heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Chanhe' kiento ab'il ol yab' syail heb' yuj heb'.
Palta a in ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol elta heb' inhtilal chi' t'a jun lugar chi', ol in yak'an serwil heb' t'a jun lugar tik, xchinak Dios chi'.

Hanhejtona', yak'nakxikan sti' Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Yalannakkan t'a winh to tz'och jun yechel t'a sniwanil winh yet' t'a jantaknhej heb' yinhtilal winh, yik wach' scheklajeli to ay strato Dios yet' heb'. Ha jun yechel chi', haton jun skuch kirkunkisión. Yuj chi', ayik yalji jun yuninal winhaj Abraham skuch Isaac, yukub'ixial yalji, yak'ji kirkunkidar yuj winhaj Abraham chi'. Hanhejtona' yalji pax jun yuninal winhaj Isaac chi' skuch Jacob, ak'jipax kirkunkidar yuj winhaj Isaac chi'. Haxo winhaj Jacob chi', lajchawanh heb' yuninal winh aljinak. Laj ak'ji kirkunkidar heb' smasanil. Ha heb' lajchawanh chi', haton heb' ko mam kicham a onh israel onh tik.

Ha t'a skal heb' ko mam kicham chi', ay jun winh yuk'tak heb' skuchan José. Ha junel meltzajoch heb' yuk'tak winhaj José chi' ajk'olal t'ay. Yuj chi' schonhb'at winh heb' t'a Egipto, palta haxo Dios och yet' winh.

Ha Dios chi' kolanelta winh t'a skal juntzanh syaelal. Yak'an sjelanil t'a winh. Och yet' winh, yik wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh winh sreyal heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' yak'och yopisio winhaj José chi' winh yoch yajalil t'a Egipto chi'. Hanhejtona', yak'och winhaj José chi' winh yilumalok spat.

Palta ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ja jun niwan wejel t'a yib'anh masanil heb' aj Egipto chi' yet' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Canaán. Te ya' ek' heb' yuj jun wejel chi'. Icha pax chi' heb' ko mam kicham ay t'a Canaán chi', manhxa b'aj wach' skot tas syab'lej heb'.
Haxo yab'an winhaj Jacob chi' to ay ixim trigo t'a Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' schekb'at heb' yuninal winh chi' ta', haton heb' ko mam kicham. Sb'ab'elalto heb' b'at t'a jun chi'.
Haxo schekjixib'at heb' t'a schaelal, hato ta' yal winhaj José chi' t'a heb' to yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' heb'. Icha chi' aj yojtakanel winhaj Faraón chi' mach heb' yetchonhab' winhaj José chi'.
Haxo winhaj José chi' chekan ik'jib'at winhaj Jacob t'ay, haton winh smam winh. Schekan ik'jib'at heb' yuk'tak yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' pax heb' yuninal heb' smasanil, 75 sb'isul heb'.
Icha chi' aj sk'och winhaj Jacob chi' t'a Egipto chi'. Hata' cham winh. Junjunal champax heb' ko mam kicham chi' ta'.

Ichato chi' yik'jixikot sniwanil winh chi' yuj heb' junelxo t'a chonhab' Siquem. Haxo ta' ak'jinakoch sniwanil heb' chi' t'a yol jun k'een nhak'een. Ha jun k'een chi', atax winhaj Abraham manannakkanel k'een t'a heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor aj chonhab' Siquem chi'.

Haxo yik wanxo sk'och stiempoal yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi', ayik yak'annakkan sti' t'a winh, q'uib'chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilal winh t'a Egipto chi'. Te tzijtum aj sb'isul heb' ta'.
k'ojank'olalto och junxo winh sreyal heb' aj Egipto chi'. Ha jun winh chi', manhxo yojtakok yab'ixal winhaj José chi' winh.

Ha jun winh rey chi', yixtejnak wal heb' ko mam kicham chi' winh. Yak'nak wal chukal winh t'a heb'. Yalannak winh t'a heb' to yowalil syumel jantaknhej heb' swinak unin heb' tzato alji, yik munil syak'cham sb'a heb' b'aj sb'at yumjikanel chi'.
Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' alji winhaj Moisés. Te wach' aj winh t'a yichanh Dios. Oxenhej ujal q'uib'tzitaj winh yuj smam snun t'a yol spat.
Slajwi chi', yaktajkan winh yuj ix snun icha syal jun ley chi'. Haxo jun ix yisil winh rey chi' ilanelta winh. Yik'anb'at winh ix t'a spat. Sq'uib'tzitan winh ix icha wal junok yune'.
Haxo winhaj Moisés chi' sk'ayb'ej winh jantaknhej tas yojtak heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' te jelan aj slolon winh. Jelan pax aj winh sk'ulan masanil tastak.
Ayik 40 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh, sja t'a spensar winh b'at yilan heb' yetchonhab', haton heb' ketisraelal.

Haxo sk'och winh, yilan winh to ay jun winh aj Egipto chi' wan yak'an chukal t'a jun winh yetchonhab' winh. Yuj chi' och winh yet' winh. Haxo winh ak'anek' spak winh yetchonhab' chi' ayik smak'ancham winh aj Egipto chi' winh.
Snaan winhaj Moisés chi' to snachajel yuj heb' yetchonhab' winh chi' to ha Dios wan yak'lab'an winh yik skolankanel heb'. Palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u sk'och winh t'a chawanhxo heb' yetchonhab'. Yilan winh to wan stzuntzan sb'a heb'. Ha snib'ej winhaj Moisés chi' to tz'och heb' t'a junk'olal, yuj chi' yal winh t'a heb': Ex wetchonhab', ¿tas yuj tzeyak' owal? Ina eyetchonhab' he b'a, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Palta haxo winh wan yak'an owal chi' ik'anel winhaj Moisés chi'. Yalan winh t'a winh: ¿Mach ix ach ak'anoch juezal, yik tzonh ak'an mandar?
¿Tom a gana tzin a mak'paxchamok icha utej jun winh aj Egipto ewi? xchi winh.
Slajwinhej yab'an jun chi' winhaj Moisés chi', sb'atkan winh elelal. Sk'ochkan kajan winh t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol yik Madián. Haxo ta' alji chawanh yuninal winh.
Ayxom 40 ab'ilok sk'och winh ta', sb'at winh t'a tzalan Sinaí, b'aj malaj anima. Haxo ta' sch'ox sb'a jun ángel t'a winh. Ayek' t'a skal jun k'ak' b'aj wan stz'a jun te' q'uiix.
Haxo yik yilanb'at jun chi' winh, tonhej te sat sk'ool winh. Yuj chi' b'at winh yilb'ati, haxo Dios Kajal halan t'a winh:

Ha in ton tik, jun Dios b'aj yak'nak em sb'a heb' a mam icham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, xchi t'a winh. Haxo winhaj Moisés chi', te ib'xik'e winh yuj xiwelal. Majxo ochlaj k'elan winh t'ay.
Yalan Dios Kajal chi' t'a winh: Kichel a xanhab', yujto ha t'a jun lugar b'aj ayach ek' tik, a inton ayinek' t'ay.

Ha heb' in chonhab' ayek' t'a Egipto, swila' to wan yab'an syail heb' ta'. Swab'anpaxi to sk'akwi heb' yab'an syail. Yuj chi' in jawi wik'elta heb' t'a skal syaelal chi'. Yuj chi', ixik. Ol ach in chekb'at t'a Egipto chi', xchi Dios chi' t'a winh.

T'a peka' maj chajoklaj winh yuj heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Malaj ochnak winh t'a heb'. Yalannak heb' t'a winh: ¿Mach ach ak'anoch juezal, yuj chi' tzonh ak' mandar? xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta ha Dios ak'an yopisio winh yak'an mandar heb'. Yak'jipax yopisio winh yik syik'elta heb' t'a skal yaelal chi'. Ha jun ángel sch'ox sb'a t'a winh t'a skal te' q'uiix chi', a och yet' winh.
Haton winhaj Moisés chi' ik'annakelta heb' ketchonhab' t'a Egipto chi'. 40 ab'il sch'oxnak juntzanh milagro winh t'a Egipto chi' yet' t'a ha' Chakchak Mar yet' pax t'a tzinan lu'um.
Haton winh alannak icha tik t'a heb' ketisraelal chi': Ha Dios ol sik'anelta jun schekab' t'a skal heb' ketchonhab' icha ix yutej in sik'anelta a in tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ek'nak winh yet' heb' ko mam kicham t'a jun takinh lu'um. Aypaxek' jun ángel yet' heb', haton jun lolonnak yet' winh t'a tzalan Sinaí. Ha t'a winhaj Moisés chi', hata' yalnakkan juntzanh lolonel Dios tz'ak'an ko k 'inal. Haxo winh alannakkan t'ayonh.
Palta a heb' ko mam kicham chi', maj yal sk'ool heb' sk'anab'ajej tas yal winh chi'. Yuj chi' spatikejel winh heb'. Snib'ej heb' meltzaj t'a Egipto.
Yalan heb' t'a winhaj Aarón: B'o juntzanhok ko diosal yik tzonh skuchb'ani, yujto a winhaj Moisés chi', jun winh ix onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, manh kojtakok tas ix ik'an winh, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', sb'oan jun k'een heb' icha kelem wakax. Ha jun chi' yak'och heb' sdiosalok. Smilanpax juntzanh nok' nok' heb' silab'ok t'ay. Yak'anoch sq'uinhal jun sdiosal heb' sb'o chi'.

Yuj chi', yik'el sb'a Dios t'a skal heb'. Aktajkan heb' sch'okoj yik wach' syak'em sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh k'anal ay t'a satcha'anh. Stz'ib'ejnakkan jun schekab' Dios icha tik: Ex israel, ayik yek'nak 40 ab'il heb' he mam eyicham t'a tzinan lu'um, manhok t'ayin snhusnak silab' heb' yet' yofrenda.

Malaj jab'ok tas eyak'nak t'ayin. Palta a jun he diosal skuch Moloc, b'akhb'il yet'tal eyuuj yet' jun yechel k'anal skuch Renfán, a juntzanh chi' eyalnak och he diosalok. Ha t'a juntzanh yechel he b'onak chi', hata' eyalnak he b'a. Yuj chi' ol ex wik'kanel t'a jun he lu'um tik, haxo ex wak'ankanb'at t'a yichanhb'at Babilonia, xchikan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

Palta ayik yek'nak heb' ko mam kicham chi' t'a tzinan lu'um chi', yet'nak jun yet'tal sley Dios heb'. Haton jun yet'tal chi' b'onakkan yuj winhaj Moisés chi', icha ajnak yalan Dios chi' t'a winh, ayik sch'oxannak jun yechel t'a winh.

Ha jun yet'tal chi', k'ojank'olal kannak t'a juntzanhxo heb' ko mam kicham. Haxo winhaj Josué ik'annakkot jun chi' yet' heb'. Ayik yikannak jun sluum heb' ch'ok chonhab'il tik heb', haton heb' pechb'ilel yuj Dios. Ha jun yet'tal sley Dios chi', yet'nak heb', masanto ochnak winhaj David sreyalok heb'.
Ha winhaj David chi', te niwan swach'k'olal Dios schanak winh. Yuj chi', snib'ej winh sb'onak jun stemplo Dios, haton jun Dios b'aj yak'nakem sb'a winhaj Jacob, haton pax ko Diosal.
Palta hato wal winhaj Salomón b'oannak stemplo Dios chi',
wach'chom ha Dios yelxo wal te niwan yelk'ochi, max aj t'a junok templo b'ob'il yuj heb' anima. Yalnakkan jun schekab' t'a peka' icha tik:
Ha satcha'anh, haton in despacho. Haxo yol yib'anhk'inal, icha sk'anh wok yaji. Yuj chi', ¿tasto wal ol eyutok he b'oan junok in templo? Malaj junok lugar b'aj syal wik'an wip.
Yujto a in ix in b'o masanil juntzanh tik, xchi Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

Palta a ex tik, te pit ex. Lajan wal he pensar yet' heb' manh ojtannakok Dios. Max eyak'och he chikin t'a slolonel. Tonhej tze makoch waan Yespíritu Dios. Yuj chi', lajan ex yet' heb' ko mam kicham chi'.

Ina heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', laj yab'nak syail heb' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'. Haton heb' schekab' Dios chi' alannakkani to ol jawok winh tojol spensar, palta milb'ilcham heb' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'. Haxo ix jawi jun tojol spensar chi', a exxo ix eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix eyak'an miljokchamok.
Wach'chom ak'b'ilkan juntzanh scheknab'il Dios t'ayex yuj heb' ángel, palta max he k'anab'ajej, xchi winhaj Esteban chi' t'a heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', ix te och pitz'an t'a spixan heb', ix kot yowal heb' t'a winhaj Esteban chi'. Ix sk'ux wal ye heb' skot yowal.

Palta haxo winhaj Esteban chi', te ay wal och Yespíritu Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' ix k'e k'elan winh t'a satcha'anh, ix yilank'e stzikikial Dios winh. Ix yilan winh to linhanek' Jesús t'a swach'k'ab' Dios chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Inai, a swilani to jakan spuertail satcha'anh. Swilani to a jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios yoch animail, linhanek' t'a swach' k'ab' Dios chi' tiknaik, xchi winh.
Haxo heb' ayek' ta', ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yawaji. Ix smakan schikin heb'. Ix kot nhilnaj heb' t'a winh, ix jachjiel winh t'a stiel chonhab' yuj heb'.

Ha heb' ix ak'anb'at t'a yib'anh winhaj Esteban chi', ix skichel spatik sk'apak junjun heb', ix yak'ankanb'at heb' t'a jun winh skuch Saulo, yik wach' a winh tz'ilankani. Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan heb' sjulancham winhaj Esteban chi' yet' k'een k'een.
Ayik wan sjulk'enan cham winh chi' heb', ix lesalwi winh t'a Dios. --Mamin Jesús, cha in pixan, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix em kuman winh. Te chaanh ix yutej sjaj winh slesalwi t'a Dios: --Mamin, manh ak'kanoch jun smul heb' tik t'a yib'anh, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix cham winh.

Te lokan winhaj Saulo yet' heb' ix milancham winhaj Esteban chi'. Haton wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix och ijan heb' anima yak'anoch syaelal heb' kreyente t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yab'an wal syail heb' sik'lab'il. Yuj chi' ix laj saklemb'at heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' t'a yol yik Judea yet' Samaria. Haxonhej heb' schekab' Jesús ix kan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ix lajwinhej scham winhaj Esteban chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh ayoch spensar t'a Dios ix ik'anb'at sniwanil winh chi', ix b'at smukanem winh heb'. Ix te ok' heb' winh yuj winh.

Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', ix yak' wal chukal winh t'a heb' kreyente. Yalnhej b'aj ayek' heb', ix laj och winh t'a yol spat heb'. Ix laj yik'elta heb' winh winak winh yet' heb' ix ix, ix b'at yak'anoch heb' winh t'a preso.
Haxo heb' kreyente ix el t'a Jerusalén, ix laj saklemb'at heb'. Masanil b'ajtak ix laj k'och heb' ix laj yalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il heb'.
Ay jun winh skuch Felipe ix k'och t'a jun chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria. Ix yalkanel yab'ixal Cristo winh t'a skal heb'.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix smaklej wal yab' heb' tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix yilanpax juntzanh milagro heb' ix sb'o winh.

Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzijtum heb' anima ayoch heb' enemigo t'ay, haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix laj ik'anel heb' t'a heb'. Ix laj el yaw heb' yel t'a heb'. Tzijtum heb' sikb'inakeli yet' heb' max yal sb'eyi, ix laj b'oxikan heb' yuj winh.
Yuj juntzanh chi' ix te tzalaj sk'ool heb' anima smasanil t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Palta ay jun winh winak skuch Simón ta'. Ste ak'ej wal musansatil heb' anima winh, yujto te niwan yelk'och winh yalani, ay tas syal yuj winh yalani.
Masanil heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwan yelk'ochi, jun lajan syak'och spensar heb' t'a winh, syalan heb': --Ha winhaj Simón, haton jun Dios skuchan Niwan Spoder, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Syak' wal och spensar heb' t'a winh, yujto pekatax syamnakoch winh yak'an musansatil heb', syalan winh to tzuji yuj.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix alanel t'a skal heb' tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ix yalanel yab'ixal Jesucristo winh t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ay heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool tas ix yal winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix schaan sbautismo heb'.

Icha pax chi' winhaj Simón chi', ix yak'och slolonel Dios winh t'a sk'ool. Ix schaan pax sbautismo winh. Ix lajwinhej chi', junxonhej ix ek' winh yet' winhaj Felipe chi'. Ay juntzanh milagro ix sch'ox winhaj Felipe chi', te niwan yelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix te sat sk'ool winhaj Simón chi' yilani.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús ayek' t'a Jerusalén, ayik ix yab'an heb' to ay heb' aj Samaria ix ak'anoch slolonel Dios t'a sk'ool, ix schekb'at winhaj Pedro heb' yet' winhaj Juan yil heb'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh, ix lesalwi heb' winh yuj heb' kreyente aj Samaria chi', yik wach' tz'ak'ji Espíritu Santo t'a heb',
yujto manta junok heb' schaani. Anhejanto t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús b'aj ix ak'ji bautizar heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' ix ak'anek' sk'ab' t'a sjolom heb'. Ichato chi' ix schaankan Espíritu Santo chi' heb'.
Ix yilan winhaj Simón chi' to ayik ix yak'anek' sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sjolom heb' kreyente chi', ix schakan Espíritu Santo heb', yuj chi' ix yaltej tumin winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Hak'ek wopisio heyet'ok yik wach' yalnhej mach ol wak'ek' in k'ab' t'a sjolom, ol schakan Espíritu Santo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pedro t'a winh: --Ach satokab'el yet' k'een a tumin chi', yujto a jun tas syak' Dios t'a nab'anhej ix a nib'ej a man yet' jab' a tumin tik.
Malaj halan ik ket'ok. Malaj och t'a jun kopisio tik, yujto manh tojolok a pensar t'a yichanh Dios.
Yuj chi' na a b'a yuj jun a chukal tik. k'an t'a Dios, tope ol ach yak' niwank'olal yuj tas wan a naan tik.
Yujto swila' to anhej chichonk'olal tza na'a, yujto anhej chukal wan ak'an serwil, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi winh: --Tze k'an wal t'a Dios Kajal wuuj, yik manh ol jawok jun yaelal tzeyal tik t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Haxo pax winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi', ix yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh. Ix yalanpaxel slolonel Dios Kajal heb' winh t'a Samaria chi'. Ixlajwi chi', yakb'an wan smeltzajxib'at heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, tzijtum juntzanh yunetak chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria chi' b'aj ix ek' heb' winh yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.

Ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix halan icha tik t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Ak' lista a b'a. Ixik t'a sur, t'a jun b'e skot t'a Jerusalén, sk'och t'a chonhab' Gaza, xchi. Ha jun b'e chi', haton jun tzek' t'a tzinan lu'um.

Yuj chi', ix yak' lista sb'a winh, ix b'at winh. Haxo t'a yol b'e chi', ix yil-laj sb'a winh yet' jun winh aj Etiopía. Ha jun winh chi' ay yopisio winh yuj ix Candace, ix yajal yaj t'a Etiopía chi'. Sik'um tumin yaj winh t'a ix. Ix xit'ek' winh yak'em sb'a t'a Dios t'a Jerusalén.
Wan spax winh t'a Etiopía chi'. k'ojanem winh t'a yol jun skarruaje. Wan yilan Slolonel Dios winh tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías, haton winh schekab' Dios.
Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Ixik, nitzb'at a b'a t'a stz'ey jun karruaje chi', xchi.

Haxo ix k'och winh t'a stz'ey, ix yab'an winh to wan yawtan Slolonel Dios winh, haton jun tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh: --¿Tzam nachajel uuj tas wan awtan chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Tato malaj mach tzin k'ayb'ani, ¿tas ol aj snachajel wuuj? ¿Max am yal a k'eta t'a yol karruaje tik yik tzach em k'ojan wet'ok? xchi winh t'a winhaj Felipe chi'

Ha Slolonel Dios wan yawtan winh chi', haton jun tz'alan icha tik: Icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj ol b'at chamok, icha chi' ol aj yik'jib'at jun Schekab' Dios Kajal schami. Icha junok nok' kalnel tz'innhej xchi sjoxchaji, icha pax chi' ol ajok.
Te q'uixwelal ol yutej heb'. Toxonton manh ol sb'o yaj jab'ok heb' t'ay. Malaj junok mach ol alanok tato ay yinhtilal ol kanok, yujto ol miljokchamok, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Al t'ayin, ¿mach ay yab'ixal jun yalnakkan winh schekab' Dios chi'? ¿Tom a yab'ixal winh yalnakkani, ma to ch'ok junokxo mach yalnakkan yab'ixal winh? xchi winh aj Etiopía chi'.
Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix halan t'a winh tas syalelk'och Slolonel Dios chi'. Ix syamanoch winh yalan yab'ixal Jesucristo t'a winh.
Ayik wan sb'at heb' winh t'a yol b'e chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a jun ha ha'. Ix yalan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a winh: Ina jun ha ha' tik, ¿max am yal in ak'ankan bautizar tiknaik? xchi winh.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan winh to syamjioch waan jun skarruaje winh chi'. Ix em heb' winh schawanhil t'a yol jun ha ha' chi'. Haxo ta' ix ak'jikan bautizar winh.

Ayik ix lajwi sk'exta heb' winh t'a yol ha ha' chi', haxo Yespíritu Dios ix ik'anb'at winhaj Felipe chi'. Yuj chi' majxo iljilaj winh yuj winh aj Etiopía chi', majxo yil-laj winh b'aj ix k'och winh. Palta te tzalajk'olal ix b'atxikan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a yol b'e chi'.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi', ha t'a chonhab' Azoto ix k'och winh. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix b'atxi winh. Ix laj ek' yalankanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il winh t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', masanto ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Cesarea.
Haxo winhaj Saulo, max yaktej winh yalani to ol smilcham heb' tz'ak'anoch Jesús Kajal t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' ix k'och winh t'a winh sat sakerdote.

Ix sk'anan juntzanh ch'anh karta winh, yik syik'anb'at ch'anh winh t'a yoltak spatil kulto ay t'a chonhab' Damasco. Ha juntzanh karta chi' tz'ak'an sderecho winh yik syaman jantaknhej heb' syak'och spensar t'a Jesús, wach'chom winak ma ix, yik syik'kot heb' winh preso t'a Jerusalén.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh, palta haxo yik wan sk'och winh t'a slak'anil chonhab' Damasco chi', ix emul kopnaj jun sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh winh.
Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel. Ix yalan icha tik: --Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi t'a winh.
--Mamin, ¿mach ach? xchi winh. --Ha in ton tik Jesús in. Ha in wal tzin ixtej.
--Q'ueanh waan, ixik t'a chonhab' chi'. Hata' ol alchaj t'ayach tas yowalil ol a k'ulej, xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Haxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Saulo chi', ix wanaj heb' winh, ix sat sk'ol heb' winh yuj xiwelal. Ix yab' heb' winh to ay mach sloloni, palta malaj mach ix yil heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e waan winhaj Saulo chi' t'a sat lu'um. Haxo yik ix elta k'elan winh, majxo yal-laj yilan jab'ok winh. Yuj chi' a heb' winh yetb'eyum winh ix yaman sk'ab', ix sketzanb'at winh heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' Damasco chi'.
Haxo ix k'och winh ta', oxe' k'ual majxo yal-laj yilan winh. Majxo walaj winh. Majxo yuk'paxlaj ha' winh.
Ha t'a Damasco chi' ay jun winh kreyente skuchan Ananías, haxo Jesús Kajal ix halan t'a winh icha t'a wayichal icha tik: --Ach Ananías, xchi. --Tik ay in Mamin, xchi winh.
--Ixik t'a jun kalle skuch Tojol. Ayik tzach k'och t'a spat winhaj Judas, tza k'anb'an t'a winh yuj winhaj Saulo aj Tarso. Ol ilani to wan slesalwi winh.
Ay jun tas ix in ch'ox t'a winh. Ix yilan winh to a ach ol ach k'ochok, ol ak'anek' a k'ab' t'a sjolom winh, yik wach' ol jakwokxikan sat winh, xchi Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh.
Palta haxo ix yalan winh: --Mamin, tzijtum mach ix halan t'ayin yuj winhaj Saulo chi'. Ha t'a Jerusalén manh jantakok chukal ix yak' winh t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch t'a sk'ool.
Xal tiknaik ix ja winh t'a tik, yik syamji jantaknhej heb' syal sb'a t'ayach yuj winh, yujto ak'b'il yopisio winh yuj heb' winh sat sakerdote, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanxi Jesús Kajal chi' t'a winh: --Ixik, yujto a winhaj Saulo chi', ix in sik'el winh, yik wach' ol yalel in lolonel winh t'a skal heb' manh israelok, t'a yichanh heb' rey yet' t'a skal heb' eyetisraelal.
Ha in ol in ch'ox t'a winh, jantak syaelal yowalil ol yab' winh wuuj, xchi Jesús Kajal chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Ananías chi' t'a jun pat chi'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix och winh t'a yool. Ix yak'anek' sk'ab' winh t'a sjolom winhaj Saulo chi'. Ix yalan winh: --Wuk'tak Saulo, a Kajal Jesús, jun ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayach t'a yol b'e b'aj ach jawi chi', ha' in chekankot t'ayach, yik wach' ol jakwokxi a sat, haxo yochkan Espíritu Santo t'ayach, xchi winh t'a winh.
Junanto rato chi' ix elta tziknaj juntzanh icha stumin nok' chay ayoch t'a yol sat winh, ichato chi' ix b'oxikan yilan winh. Ix k'e waan winh, ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wa winh, ix yik'anxi yip winh. Ix aj jaye' k'ual winh yet' heb' kreyente t'a Damasco chi'.
Ha winhaj Saulo chi', ix syamoch winh yalel slolonel Dios t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Ix yalan winh to a Jesús, Yuninal ton Dios.

Jantaknhej heb' ix ab'an yalan winh, ix te sat sk'ool heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Haton jun winh tik ix ak'anoch syaelal heb' syal sb'a t'a Jesús t'a Jerusalén. Ha ko naani to sja winh ul syam heb' kreyente t'a tik, yik syik'b'at heb' winh t'a heb' winh sat sakerdote, xchi heb'.

Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', ix ste ak'ej yip winh yalaneli, yik wach' scheklajeli to a Jesús t'a wal yel Cristo toni, haton jun tanhwab'il yuj heb'. Haxo heb' israel aj Damasco chi', maj nachajel jab'ok yuj heb' tas syutej heb' spakan t'a winh.
Ayik niwanxo tiempo ix eq'ui, ix slajtian sb'a heb' israel t'a spatik winhaj Saulo chi'. Ix yalan heb' to ol smilcham winh heb'.
Palta ix yab' spekal winh to k'ual t'ak'wal stanhwan heb' t'a juntzanh b'e sb'at t'a stiel chonhab', yik hata' smilcham winh heb' snaani.
Yuj chi', a heb' kreyente ix ak'anem winh t'a yol jun xuuk, haxo t'a swentenail smuroal jun chonhab' chi' ix yak'em t'unhunhok winh heb' t'ak'walil. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajel winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och winhaj Saulo chi' t'a Jerusalén, ix snib'ej winh smolb'ej sb'a yet' heb' kreyente ta', palta tonhej ix xiwk'e heb' smasanil t'a winh. Maj schalaj yab' heb' tato yel kreyentexo winh.

Palta a jun winh skuch Bernabé ix ik'anb'at winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ha winhaj Saulo tik, ix yil Kajal Jesús winh t'a yol b'e. Ix lolonpax Kajal Jesús chi' yet' winh. Yuj chi' malaj mach b'aj ix xiw winh yalanel yab'ixal Jesús t'a chonhab' Damasco chi', xchi winhaj Bernabé chi'.
Yuj chi' ix aj winhaj Saulo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Junnhej ix ek' winh yet' heb' kreyente ta'.
Ix ste tek'b'an sb'a winh yalanel yab'ixal Kajal Jesús. Ix stelan sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal tz'alan sti' heb' griego. Palta a heb' chi', ix slajtiej sb'a heb' yik smilancham winh heb'.
Haxo ix yab'an spekal jun chi' heb' kreyente, ix yik'anb'at winhaj Saulo chi' heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Ixlajwi sk'och heb' yet' winh ta', ix schekankanb'at winh heb' t'a chonhab' Tarso.

Ichato chi', ix och waan spechji b'eyek' heb' kreyente t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judea, t'a yol yik Galilea yet' t'a yol yik Samaria. Ix laj stek'b'itan sb'a heb'. Te naannhej Kajal Jesús yuj heb'. Ix och Yespíritu Dios yet' heb', yuj chi' ix te q'uib' sb'isul heb'.
Ha junel, ayik ix ek' winhaj Pedro yil heb' yetkreyenteal, ix k'och winh t'a heb' kreyente t'a chonhab' Lida.
Hata' ix ilchaj jun winh skuch Eneas yuj winh. Swajxakilxo ab'il stelwikan winh, yujto sikb'inakel winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh: --Ach Eneas, swal t'ayach, a Jesucristo tz'ak'an b'oxok a k'ool. Yuj chi' k'eanh waan, pak a waynub' tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Wal t'a jun rato chi', ix k'e wan winh.
Haxo heb' anima smasanil aj Lida chi' yet' heb' aj Sarón, ix yil heb' to ix b'oxikan winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb', ix yak'anoch spensar heb' t'a Kajal Jesús.
Ha t'a chonhab' Jope, ay jun ix kreyente skuchan Tabita. Haxo t'a ti' griego Dorcas sb'i ix. Te wach' ix, skolwaj ix t'a heb' meb'a'.
Haxo t'a jun tiempo chi', ix yamchaj ix yuj jun yab'il, ix cham ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'ikchajel sniwanil ix, ix ik'jik'e t'a yol jun kuarto t'a chaanh.

Ha jun chonhab' Jope chi', ha t'a slak'anil chonhab' Lida ay, haton b'aj ayek' winhaj Pedro chi'. Haxo ix yab'an heb' kreyente to hata' ayek' winh, ix schekanb'at chawanh winak heb' t'a winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Kotanh, konh ket'ok t'a Jope wal tiknaik, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Pedro chi' yet' heb' winh. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix ik'jik'e winh t'a jun kuarto b'aj ay sniwanil ix Dorcas chi'. Hata' molanek' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Wan yok' heb' ix yuj ix. Ay juntzanh spichul heb' ix yet' juntzanh skamix sb'onak ix Dorcas chi' ayik pitzanto ix. Ix sch'oxan juntzanh chi' heb' ix t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.

Haxo winh ix chekanxiemta heb' smasanil. Ixlajwi chi' ix em kuman winh, ix lesalwi winh. Ix och k'elan winh t'a ix Dorcas chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ach Tabita, swal t'ayach, k'eanh waan, xchi winh t'a ix. Haxo ix elta k'elan ix. Ix yilanoch winhaj Pedro chi' ix, ix k'e k'ojan ix.
Ha winh ix yaman sk'ab' ix. Ix sketzank'e waan ix winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtanxik'e heb' ix ix chi' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' kreyente. Ix sch'oxanelta ix winh t'a heb' to ix pitzwixi ix.
Haxo heb' aj Jope chi', ix laj yab' spekal jun chi' heb'. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'ool.
Ha winhaj Pedro chi', ixto ek' jayexo k'ual winh t'a Jope chi', haxo t'a spat jun winh skuchan Simón smunlaj yet' nok' tz'um ix aj winh.
Ha t'a chonhab' Cesarea ay jun winh skuch Cornelio, yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado skuchan aj Italia.
Syak' wal och spensar winh t'a Dios. Te ay xiwk'olal winh t'ay yet' jantak heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winh yet'ok. Tzijtum tas syak'pax winh t'a heb' israel te meb'a'. Slesalwi wal winh t'a Dios.
Haxo junel t'a tz'eymajk'ualxo, ix yilan winh icha t'a wayich, ay jun yángel Dios ayoch t'a yol jun kuarto b'aj ayek' winh chi'. Ix yalan jun ángel chi' t'a winh: --Cornelio, xchi.

Ix och k'elan winh t'ay. Ix te xiw winh yuj. --Mamin, ¿tas tzal t'ayin? xchi winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winh: --Ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Ix yilanpax juntzanh a silab' ix ak' t'a heb' meb'a'. Maj satlaj sk'ool t'a juntzanh chi'.
Ha , chekb'at jaywanhok heb' winh winak t'a chonhab' Jope, yik b'at yik'kot winhaj Simón heb' winh, haton winh skuchpax Pedro.
Ayek' winh t'a spat jun winh sk'exul, haton jun winh smunlaj yet' nok' tz'uum. Ha spat winh chi', ha t'a sti' ha' mar ay, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi spax jun ángel chi', ix yawtankot chawanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio chi' yet' pax jun winh soldado yak'umaltaxon serwil winh yaji. Ha jun winh soldado chi', anhej t'a Dios ayoch spensar winh.
Jantaknhej tas ix yal jun ángel chi', ix laj yal winh t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u t'a chimk'ualil, ayik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a slak'anil Jope chi', haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix k'e winh lesal t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat winhaj Simón chi'.
Ayik ayek' winh ta', ix och swejel winh. Ix sk'anan wa sb'a winh. Palta haxo yik wan to sb'oji tas ol yab'lej winh chi', icha t'a wayichal
ix aj yilan winh sjakwi satcha'anh. Haxo ix yilan winh ichato ay jun k'apak yamb'il schikintak schanhil, ix emul t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat b'aj ayek' winh chi'.
Haxo t'a yol jun k'apak chi', hata' ayoch junjun makan nok' nok'. Ay nok' chanhe' yok. Ay pax nok' chan yet' nok' much.
Ixlajwi yemul jun chi', ix yab'an winhaj Pedro chi', ix och jun lolonel, ix yalan icha tik: --Pedro, mak'cham juntzanh nok' tik a chi'a, xchi.
Palta ix yalan winh: --Ach Wajalil, max yal-laj, yujto manta jun elok tzin chi junok komon tasi, ma junok tas ay yowalil yuj ley Moisés, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan junelxo: --Ha juntzanh tas syal Dios to malaj yowalil, a achxo tik, manh ala' to ay yowalil, xchi.
Oxel ix alchaj icha chi'. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix ik'jixik'e jun k'apak chi' t'a satcha'anh.
Wanto snaan winhaj Pedro tas yaj jun chi', ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio t'a sti' jun pat chi'. Toxo ix sk'anb'ej heb' winh yab'i b'aj ay spat winhaj Simón chi'.
Yuj chi' ix awajoch heb' winh, ix sk'anb'an heb' winh: --¿Ay am ek' winhaj Simón t'a tik, winh skuchpax Pedro? xchi heb' winh.
Hanheja' wanto snaan winhaj Pedro yuj juntzanh ix yil chi', ix yalan Yespíritu Dios t'a winh: --Ay oxwanh heb' winh winak tzach k'anb'ani.
Yuj chi' emanh. Ixik yet' heb' winh, manh chab'k'olalok tzach b'ati, yujto a in ix in chekkot heb' winh, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix emta winh b'aj ayek' heb' winh schekab' winhaj Cornelio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ina in tzin he k'anb'ej tik. ¿Tas he chekab'il t'ayin yuj chi' tzex jawi? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Ay jun winh yajal soldado skuch Cornelio. Te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, syak'paxem sb'a winh t'a Dios. Te wach' winh t'a yichanh heb' etisraelal smasanil. Haxo jun yángel Dios ix halan t'a winh to schekkot heb' schekab' winh yik tzach yik'b'at heb' t'a spat winh, yik wach' smaklej yab' winh tas ol ala', xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jioch heb' winh t'a yol pat chi' yuj winh. Hata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb' winh. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh. Ix b'at jaywanh heb' kreyente aj Jope chi' yuk'lewok winh.
Hato t'a schab'jial ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea. Haxo winhaj Cornelio ix tanhwan sk'och heb' ta'. Toxo ix yawtejkot heb' sk'ab' yok winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' yamigo winh.
Ayik wan sk'och winhaj Pedro chi', ix elta winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a sti' spat. Ix schaan winh sk'och winh. Ix em kuman winh yak'em sb'a t'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
Palta a winhaj Pedro chi' ix ketzank'e waan winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Q'ueanh linhan, yujto ketanimail ko b'a, xchi winh.
Wan slolon heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a yol pat. Ix yilan winhaj Pedro chi' to tzijtumxo heb' molaneq'ui.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb': --Ex wetanimail, eyojtak to a onh israel onh tik, ay yowalil ko k'umlan ko b'a yet' junok ch'ok chonhab'il, ma koch t'a yol spat. Palta ha Dios ix ak'an wojtakejeli to max yal walani to ay yowalil tzin k'umej junok mach.
Yuj chi' malaj tas ix wala' ayik ix b'at in eyik'ankoti. Xal tiknaik, alek t'ayin, tas yuj ix b'at in eyik'koti, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yab' am icha hora tik oxji, wan in lesalwi t'a yol in pat tik, ichataxon tzin k'ulej t'a junjun tz'eymajk'ualil. Ay jun sch'ox sb'a t'ayin, kopopi kilan spichul.
Yalan t'ayin: Cornelio, ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Ix snaanpaxkot juntzanh a silab' tzak' t'a heb' meb'a'.

Haxo tiknaik, chekb'at jaywanhok winak t'a chonhab' Jope, b'at yik'ankot winhaj Simón heb', skuch pax Pedro. Ayek' winh t'a spat jun winh sk'exul, haton jun winh smunlaj yet' nok' tz'uum. Ha spat winh chi', ha t'a sti' ha' mar ay, xchi.

Slajwi chi', in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ach sayeq'ui. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach ix a k'anab'ajej a koti. Ha tiknaik, ayonh ek' ko masanil t'a yichanh Dios Kajal. Yuj chi' sko snib'ej skab'i jantaknhej tas alb'ilkan t'ayach yuj, yik tzalan t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Cornelio chi' t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb': --Ha tiknaik wojtak to t'a wal yel, jun lajannhej yelk'och masanil anima t'a yichanh Dios.
Ha heb' xiw t'a Dios, wach'chom manh israelok heb', ste tzalaj yet' heb' tato wach' sb'eyb'al heb'.
Ha Dios ak'jinakkan slolonel t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik. Yalannakkan t'ayonh to ay junk'olal yuj Jesucristo, haton Kajal ko masanil.
Ha exxo tik, ina eyojtak tas ix sk'ulej Dios t'a ko lugar. Ha t'a Galilea elnak yich, ayik slajwinak yalankanel slolonel Dios winhaj Juan, a slajwinak yak'an bautizar heb' anima winh.

Eyojtak to ha Dios yak'nak Yespíritu t'a Jesús aj Nazaret, yak'annakpax spoder t'ay. Eyojtak paxi to a Jesús ix kolwaj t'a heb' anima. Jantaknhej heb' ixtab'il yuj winh diablo, ix laj yak' b'oxok sk'ool heb'. Icha chi' yutejnak sb'a yujto ha Dios ayoch yet'ok.

Ha onh tik skak' testigoal ko b'a yuj juntzanh tastak ix sk'ulej chi'. Jantaknhej tas ix ek' sk'ulej t'a yol yik Judea yet' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, ix kila'. Ixlajwi chi', ix kulusajk'e yuj heb' wetisraelal. Icha chi' ix yutej heb' smilanchamok.
Palta haxo t'a schab'jial ix pitzwixi yuj Dios. Yuj spoder Dios chi' ix sch'ox sb'a t'ayonh.

Palta maj sch'oxlaj sb'a t'a masanil heb' anima. Anhej t'ayonh ix sch'ox sb'a, yujto atax t'a peka' sik'b'ilonhxokanel yuj yik tzonh och stestigook. Onh wa pax yet'ok ayik toxo ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak chi'.
Ix yalankan t'ayonh to yowalil tzek' kalel yab'ixal t'a heb' anima, to ha Dios ak'jinak yopisio sch'olb'itan tas yaj heb' anima smasanil, wach'chom heb' pitzanto ma heb' chamnakxo.

Atax t'a peka', ayokto yalannakkanel yab'ixal Jesús heb' schekab' Dios. Yalnakkan junjun heb' to a jantaknhej heb' ol ak'anoch Jesús chi' t'a sk'ool, ol ak'jokkan lajwok smul heb' yuj, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
Haxo yik wan yalan winhaj Pedro chi', ix ochkan Yespíritu Dios t'a masanil heb' wan yab'an chi'.
Haxo heb' kreyente aj Israel ajun yet' winhaj Pedro chi', ix te sat sk'ool heb', yujto ix yak'pax Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' manh israelok.
Yujto ix yab' heb' to ch'okch'ok ti'al syal heb' b'aj ix ochkan kajan Espíritu Santo chi'. Ix yab'anpax heb' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Pedro chi':
--Max yal sko kachoch waan heb' tik, yik max ak'ji bautizar heb'. Ina to ix ak'ji Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' icha ix aj yak'ji t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pedro chi' to tz'ak'ji bautizar heb' t'a sb'i Jesucristo. Ixlajwi yak'ji bautizar heb' chi', ix sk'anan pawor heb' t'a winh, yik wach' tz'aj jayeok k'ual winh yet' heb'.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús yet' heb' kreyente ay t'a yol yik Judea, ix yab' heb' to ay heb' manh israelok ix ak'anoch slolonel Dios t'a sk'ool.
Yuj chi' ayik ix k'ochxi winhaj Pedro t'a Jerusalén, ix yalan heb' kreyente israel to manh wach'ok ix yutej sb'a winh.
Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj ix ach xit'ek' a k'umej heb' manh israelok, ach wa pax yet' heb'? xchi heb' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb' tastak ix uji chi', ix yalan winh icha tik:
--Ayinek' t'a chonhab' Jope. Haxo t'a jun k'u, wan in lesalwi, icha wayich ix aj wilan yemul jun niwan k'apak ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Yamb'il schikintak schanhil, ix emul b'aj ay in ek' chi'.
Ix in och k'elan t'ay yik swila' tas ayoch t'a yool. Haxo ix wilani, ay juntzanh nok' kaltakte'al nok' chanhe' yok. Ay nok' ay smay. Ay nok' chan yet' juntzanh nok' much.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'an yoch jun lolonel, ix yalani: Pedro, milcham juntzanh nok' tik a chi'a, xchi.
Palta ix in tak'wi t'ay: Maay, ach Wajal, yujto manta junelok tzin chi junok komon tas, ma junok tas ay yowalil yuj ley Moisés, xin chi t'ay.
Yuj chi', ix yalanemta junelxo t'ayin t'a satcha'anh: Ha juntzanh tas syal Dios to malaj yowalil, a achxo tik, manh ala' to ay yowalil, xchi.
Oxel ix yal juntzanh chi' icha chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jixik'e jun k'apak chi' t'a satcha'anh.
Junanto rato chi' ix k'och oxwanh heb' winh t'a jun pat b'aj ayinek' chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', ha t'a chonhab' Cesarea ix chekjikot heb' winh, yik sb'at in sayan heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope.

Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, manh chab'k'olalok tzach b'at yet' heb' winh, xchi. Ix b'at pax wakwanhxo heb' winh kuk'tak tik wet'ok. Haxo ix onh k'och ta', ix onh och t'a yol spat jun winh.

Ix yalan winh t'ayonh to ix yil jun ángel winh, linhanek' t'a yol spat winh chi'. Ix yalan t'a winh: Chekb'at jaywanhok heb' winh t'a chonhab' Jope, b'at yik'okab'kot winhaj Simón heb' winh, skuchan pax Pedro.
Ha winh ol halan t'ayach tas ol aj a kolchaji yet' jantaknhej heb' ayek' t'a yol a pat, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a winh.
Haxo yik ix in och ijan walan t'a heb', t'a jun rato chi' ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb', icha ix aj yoch t'ayonh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yuj chi' ix in naankot tas alb'ilkan yuj Kajal Jesús, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Yel toni, a winhaj Juan ix ak'an bautizar heb' anima t'a ha ha'. Palta a ex tik, ol ex ak'jok bautizar yuj Yespíritu Dios, xchi.

Ha Dios ix ak'an Yespíritu t'a heb' icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayonh ayik ix kak'anoch Kajal Jesucristo t'a ko k'ool. Yuj chi', ¿tom a in tik, syal in kachanoch waan tas sk'ulej Dios? xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.

Haxo heb' kreyente t'a Jerusalén chi', ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb', manhxalaj tas ix yal heb'. Haxonhej wach' lolonel ix yal heb' t'a Dios. Ix yalan heb': --Hanhejtona' pax heb' manh israelok, ha Dios ix ak'an sna sb'a heb' yik wach' scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej ket'ok, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix miljicham winhaj Esteban, ix ak'jipax och syaelal heb' kreyente smasanil. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' elelal. Ay heb' ix k'och masanto t'a chonhab' Fenicia, t'a Chipre yet' t'a Antioquía. Ix laj yalanel wach' ab'ix heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal ayek' ta'. Palta malaj tas ix yal heb' t'a heb' manh israelok.
Palta ay jaywanh heb' kreyente aj Chipre yet' heb' aj Cirene ix k'och t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi'. Hata' ix yalel yab'ixal Jesucristo heb' t'a heb' manh israelok.
Haxo Jesús Kajal ix och yet' heb' kreyente chi', yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix sk'ex sb'eyb'al. Ix yak'anoch Kajal Jesús heb' t'a sk'ool.
Haxo heb' kreyente aj Jerusalén, ayik ix yab'an spekal jun chi' heb', ix schekb'at winhaj Bernabé heb' t'a Antioquía chi'.

Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yilan winh, te niwan swach'k'olal Dios ix yak' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj winh yuj heb'. Ix ak'ji stek'anil heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh to tek'an syutej sb'a heb', syak'anpax och spensar heb' t'a Kajal Jesús t'a masanil tiempo.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Bernabé chi' yalan t'a heb', yujto te wach' spensar winh. Te ayoch Espíritu Santo yet' winh. Syak' wal och Dios winh t'a sk'ool. Yuj chi' tzijtum wal heb' aj chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'ool yuj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a chonhab' Tarso, ix b'at sayanek' winhaj Saulo winh ta'. Haxo ix ilchaj winh yuj winh, ix yik'ankot winh winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi'.
Haxo ta' ix ek' jun ab'il heb' winh t'a skal heb' kreyente chi'. Tzijtum mach ix sk'ayb'ej heb' winh. Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', hata' ix ak'ji skuch heb' kreyente kristiano t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jaywanh heb' winh schekab' Dios ix b'at alanel slolonel. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix jawi heb' winh t'a Antioquía chi'.

Ay jun winh yetb'eyum heb' winh skuch Agabo. Ix k'e waan winh t'a skal heb' kreyente. Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix ak'an yal winh icha tik: --Ay jun niwan wejel ol jawok t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi winh. (Ha jun wejel ix yal winh chi', ha t'a stiempoal ayoch winhaj Claudio yajalil, hata' ix yak'a').
Yuj tas ix yal winhaj Agabo chi', haxo heb' kreyente aj Antioquía chi', ix el t'a sk'ool heb' to skolwaj heb' t'a heb' kreyente aj Judea, hato syala' jantak stzak'wan heb' yak'ani.
Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'. Ix yak'anb'at yofrenda heb' t'a heb' winh ankiano aj Judea chi'. Haxo winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo ix ik'anb'at jun ofrenda chi'.
Ha t'a yik jun pekti' chi', a winhaj rey Herodes, ix och ijan winh yak'an chukal t'a heb' kreyente.
Ix schekan winh tzepchajel sjolom winhaj Jacobo, haton winh yuk'tak winhaj Juan.
Ayik ix yilan winh to wach' ix yab' heb' israel yuj jun chi', yuj chi' ix schek winh yamjokpax winhaj Pedro. Ha t'a jun sq'uinh heb' israel, yik swaan ixim pan heb' malaj yich, hata' ix yamji winh.

Haxo ix yamchaj winh chi', ix ak'jioch winh t'a preso. Ix ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' waklajunhwanh heb' soldado, yik stanhwaj winh yuj heb'. Chanhtakwanh heb' ix tanhwan winh t'a juntak el. Ix snaan winhaj Herodes chi' to ayik ol lajwok q'uinh yik snajikoti tas aj yelnakkot heb' israel t'a Egipto chi', ol sch'oxanelta winhaj Pedro chi' winh t'a yichanh heb' anima, ichato chi' ol sch'olb'itan winh rey chi' tas yaj winh.
Yuj chi' te ay wal och yilumal winhaj Pedro t'a yol te' preso chi'. Haxo heb' kreyente, t'a smasanil sk'ool heb' ix lesalwi t'a Dios yuj winh. Maj ochlaj waan heb' slesalwi.

Haxo t'a jun ak'wal, k'ik'anokxo tz'elta winhaj Pedro chi' t'a yichanh heb' anima yuj winhaj Herodes chi', waynak winh t'a snanhal chawanh heb' soldado. Tzek'b'il winh t'a chab' k'een kadena. Haxo t'a sti' te' preso chi' ayek' chawanhxo heb' winh stanhwej.

Palta t'a jun rato chi' ix k'och jun yángel Dios Kajal. Te sak k 'inal ix aj t'a yol te' preso chi' yuj. Ix yekub'tanhan skostil winhaj Pedro chi' jun ángel chi', yik tz'el swayanh winh, ix yalan t'a winh: --Q'ueanh waan wal tiknaik, xchi. Haxo k'een kadena ayoch chi' t'a sk'ab' winhaj Pedro chi', munil ix el k'een, ix em lanhnaj k'een.
Ix yalanpax jun ángel chi' t'a winh: --Tzatzb'itej a tzek'ul, tzak'anoch a xanhab', xchi. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Ak'och jun spatik a pichul. Tzach och tzak'an wuuj, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj. Ix elta winh t'a jun kuarto b'aj ayek' chi'. Wan swayichan winh snaani. Manh yojtakok winh tato yel to wan yelta winh.

Ix ek' heb' t'a scha makanhil b'aj ayek' heb' soldado wan stanhwan te' preso chi', ichato chi' ix k'och heb' b'aj ay k'een smakul preso chi' b'aj sjakwiel t'a yol kalle. Ha jun k'een chi' munil ix jakwi k'een sch'okoj. Ix el heb' b'ian. Haxo ix b'at heb' t'a jun kalle chi', ix aktajkan winhaj Pedro chi' yuj jun ángel chi'.

Haxo ix yilan winh to yel. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik, swila' to yel ix schekkot jun yángel Dios Kajal tzul in skolanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Herodes. In kolchajelta t'a yalanh jantaknhej tas snib'ej heb' wetisraelal syak'och t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Wanto snaan juntzanh chi' winh, ix k'och winh t'a spat ix María, snun winhaj Juan, haton winh skuchpax Marcos. Tzijtum heb' molanek' t'a jun pat chi', wan slesalwi heb' yuj winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'onhub'tanhej spuertail yamaq'uil jun pat chi' winh. Haxo jun ix kob'es skuch Rode, a ix ix ul tak'wokelta t'a winh.

Palta haxo ix yab'an ix to a winhaj Pedro, maj sjaklaj te' puerta chi' ix. Tonhej ix te tzalaj ix. Ix ochxi lemnaj ix. Ix yalan ix t'a heb' ayek' chi' ta' to a winhaj Pedro ayek' t'a sti' puerta chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a ix: --Tekan tonhej tzach komon loloni, xchi heb'. Palta ix yalxi ix to yel a winhaj Pedro chi' ayeq'ui. Haxo ix yalanxi heb': --Tekan manhoklaj winhaj Pedro chi'. Tekan a junok ángel ayoch stanhwumalok winh, tekan a ix jawi, xchi heb' t'a ix.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi', hanheja' sk'onk'onhan och winh. Haxo ix sjakan heb', ix yilan heb' to yel a winhaj Pedro chi' ayeq'ui. Ix te sat sk'ool heb'.

Palta ix yak'an yechel winh yet' sk'ab' t'a heb' yik numan tz'aj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' tas ix aj yik'jielta winh yuj Dios Kajal t'a preso chi'. Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb': --Tzeyal juntzanh tik t'a winhaj Jacobo yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' kreyente, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winh t'a skal heb'. Ix b'at winh t'a junxo lugar.
Haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix k'e somnaj heb' soldado yalani, yujto maj nachajel yuj heb' tas ix yutej sb'a winhaj Pedro chi'.
