Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix ul sch'ox sb'a Kajal Jesús t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalan t'a winh: --Pablo, manh ach och ilk'olal, yujto icha ix utej alanel wab'ixal t'a Jerusalén tik, icha pax chi' ol utok alanel t'a chonhab' Roma, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, ay jaywanh heb' israel ix smolb'ej sb'a. Ix slajtian sb'a heb' to ol smilcham winhaj Pablo chi' heb'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh ol onh waok, manh ol kuk'pax ha' masanto sko milcham winhaj Pablo chi'. Haxo tato manh ol ko k'anab'ajej icha skal tik jun, yak'okab' ko yaelal Dios, xchi heb'.
Másto 40 heb' ix halan icha chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' t'a heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' t'a heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yak'an mandar heb' israel. Ix yalan heb': --Ix kak' ko ti' to maxto onh wa'i masanto sko milcham winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix ko k'ankot ko yaelal t'a Dios tato manh ol elk'och icha tas ix kal chi'.

Haxo tiknaik, a ex tik yet' juntzanhxo heb' sat yajal tze k'an t'a winh koronel chi' to syik'kot winhaj Pablo chi' winh t'ayex k'ik'an. Tze tz'akan eyal t'a winh to ayto wal tas he gana tzeyab' t'a winh. Ha onhxo tik, lista ol kutok ko b'a ko mak'ancham winh b'aj ol jawok chi', xchi heb' israel chi'.
Palta ay jun winh yune' ix yanab' winhaj Pablo chi' ix ab'an tas ix yal heb' chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a kuartel chi'. Ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yawtankot jun winh kapitán winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ik'b'at winh kelem tik t'a winh koronel yujto ay tas snib'ej winh b'at yal t'a winh, xchi winh.

Haxo winh kapitán chi' ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winh koronel chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yalan winh kapitán chi' t'a winh: --Ha winhaj Pablo, winh ayoch t'a preso ix in awtanb'ati. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzul wak' jun winh kelem tik t'ayach. Tob' ay tas snib'ej winh syal t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo winh koronel chi' ix ketzanel winh, ix snitzanel sb'a heb' winh schawanhil. --¿Tas a gana tzal t'ayin? xchi winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh kelem chi': --Ay heb' israel ix halani, tob' ol sk'an heb' t'ayach yik tzik'b'at winhaj Pablo t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal k'ik'an. Ol stz'akan yal heb' t'ayach to ayto wal tas snib'ej heb' syab' t'a winh.

Palta manh a cha ab'i. Yujto más am 40 heb' ol sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol b'e, yik ol smak'cham winh heb'. Yujto ix yak' sti' heb' to manh ol wa heb', malaj pax tas ol yuk' heb' masanto ol smak'cham winh heb'. Ix sk'anankot syaelal heb' t'a Dios tato manh ol elk'och icha ix yal heb' chi'. Ha tiknaik listaxo yaj heb'. Wan stanhwan heb' yab'i tato ol ak'b'at winh, xchi winh.
Haxo winh koronel chi' ix chekan pax winh kelem chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Malaj junok mach b'aj tzala' tato ix ul al jun tik t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot chawanh heb' winh kapitán winh koronel chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Tzeyak' lista chab'ok kiento soldado ol b'at t'a yok, 70 ok heb' ol b'at t'a yib'anh chej yet' chab'ok kiento heb' syik' slanza, yik sb'at heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea t'a k'e ak'walil tik.
Tzeyak'an lista jaywanhok schejal winhaj Pablo. Yujto yowalil ol eyik'b'at winh t'a winhaj Félix, winh yajal. Te lista tzeyutej he b'a yik malaj ol ik'an winh t'a yoltak b'e, xchi winh.
Ix yak'anb'at jun skarta winh t'a winhaj Félix chi'. Ha jun karta chi' icha tik syala':
Ha in Claudio Lisias in, tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun in karta tik t'ayach, ach wajalil Félix. Swak'b'at stzatzil a k'ool ta'.
Tik swak'b'at jun winh skuch Pablo t'ayach. Ha heb' israel ix yaman winh. Ijan ix mak'jicham winh yuj heb', palta ix in kol winh yet' heb' soldado yujto ix wab'i to aj Roma winh.
In gana ix wab'i tas yuj ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh winh yuj heb' israel chi'. Yuj chi' ix wik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb'.
Haxo ix wab'ani to yujnhej sley heb' ix och smul winh t'a heb'. Palta manh smojok smak'jicham winh, hanhejtona' manh smojok yoch winh t'a preso.

Palta ix wab'i to ay heb' israel ix slajtiej sb'a, ix yalan heb' to ol smilcham winh heb'. Yuj chi' swak'b'at winh t'ayach. Ix walan t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh chi' to syal sb'at heb' t'ayach, b'at yalan heb' tas wal spensar heb' t'a spatik winh. Anhej tik swalb'at t'ayach, xchi winh t'a skarta chi'.
Haxo heb' soldado chi' ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'ak'walil. Ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Antípatris.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, a heb' soldado ix kot t'a yok chi' ix meltzajxikan heb' b'aj ay skuartel chi'. Haxo heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix b'at heb' yet' winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Cesarea chi', ix yak'an ch'anh karta chi' heb' t'a winh yajal chi'. Ix yak'ankan winhaj Pablo chi' heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yilan ch'anh karta chi' winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi' tas chonhab'il b'aj kotnak winh. Haxo ix yab'an winh to aj Cilicia winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Jawokab' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a ib'anh chi'. Ichato chi' ol wab'ani tas ol ala', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to stanhwaj winh t'a yol spat winhaj Herodes b'aj syak' yajalil.

Yoilxo k'ual sk'och winhaj Pablo t'a Cesarea chi', ix k'och winhaj Ananías, winh sat sakerdote. Ajun pax jaywanh heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio yet' jun winh likenkiado skuch Tértulo. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Félix chi' yik syak'anb'at heb' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayik ix ik'jikot winh, ix och ijan winhaj Tértulo chi' yak'anb'at t'a yib'anh winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj Félix chi': --Ach kajal Félix, yuj wal Dios t'ayach, uuj junk'olal kaji. Te wach' yaj jantaknhej tas t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te jelan ach.
Te wach' ach. Ha t'a junjun lugar chekel yaji to wach'nhej tas tza k'ulej. Yuj wal Dios t'ayach.
Palta yik max kik'ek' niwanok tiempo t'ayach, ¿ma max ak' pawor ab'an jay b'elanh lolonel ko gana skal tik t'ayach?

Ha winhaj Pablo tik, skab' wal syail yuj winh. Ijan max techaj kuuj. Slaj ek' winh stzuntzej chaanh owal t'a skal heb' ketisraelal t'a junjun lugar. Yajal yaj winh t'a junxo makan k'ayb'ub'al, haton heb' syak'och spensar t'a jun winh aj Nazaret.

Ix yak'lej winh yik'anoch heb' manh israelok t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios yik tz'ixtaxel t'a yichanh Dios. Yuj chi' ix ko yam winh. Ko gana ix ko ch'olb'itej yaj winh, icha syal ch'anh ley aykan t'a yol ko k'ab',
palta haxo winhaj Lisias, winh koronel ix yekoch sb'a t'a ko kal. Ix b'at winh yik'elta winh t'a yol ko k'ab'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo tik to yowalil skot heb' t'ayach. Ha ach tik, syal a k'anb'an ab' t'a winhaj Pablo tik. Ichato chi' ol ilanelta to yel, manh nab'anhejok skik'kot t'a yib'anh winh, xchi winhaj Tértulo chi'.
Haxo heb' winh israel ajun yet' winh, ix yal pax heb' winh: --Te yel syal winhaj Tértulo tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yechel winh yajal chi' yik slolon winhaj Pablo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal yik winh icha tik: --Mamin Félix, a ach tik, wojtak to niwanxo tiempo ayach och juezal t'a ko nakión tik. Yuj chi' tzin tzalaji swalan tas waj t'ayach.
Syal ojtakaneli to yel juntzanh ol wal tik t'ayach. Manto k'ochlaj slajchawil k'ual in k'och t'a Jerusalén, yik swal in b'a t'a Dios.

Malaj junok anima tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok. Malaj pax junok lugar b'aj tzek' wak'k'e somnaj heb' anima. Manhok t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, manhok t'a yol spatil kulto, manhok pax t'a junokxo lugar t'a Jerusalén chi'. Malaj jab'ok in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch tik t'a wib'anh, malaj jab'ok tas sch'ox heb' tato yel juntzanh tas syak'och heb' tik t'a wib'anh.

Yel toni, ha Dios, haton sDiosal heb' in mam wicham, a t'ay swak' em in b'a, icha syal ko k'ayb'ub'al, haton jun makanhxo k'ayb'ub'al tik syal heb'. Palta a in tik, swak'och t'a in k'ol jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés yet' jantak tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios.
Swak' wal och Dios yipok in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak smasanil, jantaknhej heb' tojol spensar yet' pax heb' manh tojolok. Icha pax chi' sna heb' tik wet'ok.
Yuj chi' swil wal in b'a, yik max och in mul t'a Dios, yik max och pax in mul t'a heb' wetanimail.
Ay xom sjayilok ab'il manhxo in ayok ek' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Yuj chi' in k'ochxi, yik swak' jab'ok in kolwal t'a heb' meb'a' t'a skal heb' wetchonhab' tik, yik swak'an pax jab'ok in silab' t'a Dios.

Ayinek' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, yik swak'an in silab' chi'. Toxo ix in b'o in b'a ichataxon ko ley. Jaywannhej anima ayoch wet'ok, malaj mach nhilanochi. Malaj jab'ok owal ix in saya'. Palta hata' ix in syam juntzanh heb' israel aj Asia.
Tato ay wal in mul ix yil heb', kotokab' heb' t'a ichanh tik, ul yalokab' heb' tas in mul chi'. Oktom a wal heb' ix jawi.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh ayek' tik, yalokab' heb', tato ay in mul ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel ayik ix in sch'olb'itan heb'. Anhej tato mul jun tik:
Ayik ay in ek' t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal chi', te chaanh ix wal icha tik: Wan in ch'olb'itaji yujto swak'och t'a in k'ool to ol pitzwokxi heb' chamnak, xin chi, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh.

Haxo winhaj Félix chi' yojtak winh sik'lab'il tas yaj sk'ayb'ub'al heb' kreyente. Yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Kotokab' winhaj Lisias, winh koronel chi'. Ol ul yalan winh t'ayin tas wal yaj jun eyowal tik. Ichnhejokab' ta' skan b'ela, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh kapitán to hanheja' stanhwaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Palta libre wal tz'aj winh. Syal slolon winh yet' heb' swach'k'ool, syal pax yak'an heb' tas yowalil tz'och yuj winh.

Ayxom jayeok k'ual chi', ix jax winhaj Félix t'a Cesarea chi' junelxo. Ajun ix yetb'eyum winh skuch Drusila yet'ok, israel ix. Haxo winh ix awtankot winhaj Pablo chi' yik sk'anb'ej yab' winh t'a winh tas skutej kak'anoch Jesucristo t'a ko k'ool.

Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh to yowalil wach' skutej ko b'eyb'al, sko kachanoch waan ko b'a yik max ko k'ulej chukal. Ix yalanpax winh to ol ch'olb'itaj yaj heb' anima smasanil. Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix te xiw winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --k'okb'ilxo chi' tzala'. Tato ay b'aj ol och in kolanil, ol ach wawtejxikoti, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Félix chi', snib'ej winh to ix yak' jab'ok tumin winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh t'a elk'altak, yik tz'aktajel winh yuj winh. Yuj chi' tzijtum el ix awtajkot winh yuj winh yik slolon winh yet' winh.

Chab' ab'il ix yak' winh icha chi' yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix el winh t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Porcio Festo ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Haxo yik ix el winhaj Félix chi' t'a yopisio chi', ix kannhej winhaj Pablo chi' t'a yol preso chi' yuj winh yik wach' stzalaj heb' israel yet' winh.
Haxo winhaj Festo chi', ix k'och winh t'a Cesarea, yik tz'och winh yajalil. Yoxil k'ual schaan yopisio winh chi', ix k'e winh t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio, ix k'och heb' t'a winh yik sk'anoch heb' t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ix och ijan heb' sk'anan t'a winhaj Festo chi', yik wach' tz'ik'jikot winhaj Pablo chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yal heb' icha chi' yujto snib'ej heb' smilcham winh t'a yoltak b'e.
Palta ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Preso yaj winhaj Pablo chi' t'a Cesarea tiknaik. Yikto jaye' k'ual tik ol in b'atxok ta'.
Yuj chi' syal sb'at heb' eyajalil t'a Cesarea chi' wet'ok. Tato ay smul winhaj Pablo chi', syal b'at yalan heb' ta', xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix am ek' wajxakeok, ma lajunheok k'ual winhaj Festo t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxxi winh t'a Cesarea chi'. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi' winh.

Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, a heb' israel ix kot t'a Jerusalén ix k'och hoyan heb' t'a stz'ey winh. Tzijtum tas ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh winh, palta malaj jab'ok tas sch'oxani tato yel syal heb'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Toxon malaj jab'ok in mul ochnak t'a sley heb' wetisraelal. Malaj in mul ochnak t'a stemplo Dios. Malaj pax in mul ochnak t'a winh kajal t'a Roma, xchi winh.

Palta yujto snib'ej winhaj Festo chi' to wach' skan winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --¿Tzam yal a k'ol tzach b'at t'a Jerusalén yik wach' hata' ol ach in ch'olb'itej? xchi winh.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh: --Ha t'a yichanh winh kajal t'a Roma tzin k'anb'at in b'a. Anhej ta' syal in ch'olb'itaji. Ina ojtak, malaj in mul ix och t'a heb' israel tik.

Tato ay junok in mul smoj in cham yuj jun, in chamokab'i. Palta tato malaj in mul scheklaj yuj heb' israel tik, malaj junok mach syal in yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Tik tzin k'anb'at in b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Hato winh ol in ch'olb'itanok, xchi winh.

Haxo winhaj Festo chi' ix lolon winh yet' heb' tz'ak'an spensaril. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ha ach tik ix a k'anb'at a b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Yuj chi' hata' ol ach wak'b'ati, xchi winh.
Ayxom sjayilok k'ual, ichato chi' ix ja winhaj rey Agripa yet' ix Berenike t'a Cesarea chi', yik tzul sk'uman winhaj Festo chi' heb', yujto toto ix och winh t'a yopisio.

Ix ek' jaye' k'ual heb' ta'. Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Festo chi' t'a winh rey chi' tas yaj winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ayik ix el winhaj Félix t'a yopisio ay jun winh skuch Pablo ix kan t'a preso yuj winh.

Ayik ix in xit'ek' t'a Jerusalén, a heb' sat sakerdote yet' heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio ix k'och heb' t'ayin, ix yak'anoch heb' t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo chi'. Snib'ej heb' ix wak'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh.

Yuj chi' ix wal icha tik t'a heb': Ha yaj ley t'ayonh aj Roma onh tik, max yal skomon ak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima. Yowalil syil-lajoch sat yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh chi' t'a yichanh winh juez yik syak'lej yik'anel t'a yib'anh, xin chi t'a heb' aj Jerusalén chi'.
Yuj chi' haxo ix ja heb' t'a tik maj wik'ek' tiempo. Ha t'a junxo k'u ix in och t'a in despacho b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ix in chekan ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi'.
Ha in naani to ay wal smul winh. Palta haxo heb' ix ak'anoch t'a yib'anh winh chi', malaj wal smul winh ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh icha ix wutej in naani.
Anhej ix yal heb' to ay smul winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb'. Ix yalan heb' yuj jun winh chamnakxo skuch Jesús. Haxo yujto syal winhaj Pablo chi' to pitzan winh, yuj chi' syak'och heb' t'a yib'anh winh.

Ha in xo tik max nachaj wuuj tas swutej in b'oan yaj t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix in k'anb'ej icha tik t'a winhaj Pablo chi': ¿Tzam yal a k'ool tzach b'at t'a Jerusalén yik wach' hata' tzach in ch'olb'itej? xin chi t'a winh.

Palta haxo ix yalan winh t'ayin: Tik tzin k'anb'at in b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma. Hato winh ol in ch'olb'itanok, xchi winh t'ayin. Yuj chi' a inxo ix wala' to skan winh t'a preso, masanto ol wak'b'at winh t'a winh kajal chi', xchi winhaj Festo chi'.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' winhaj rey Agripa chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Festo chi': --Ha inxo tik, in gana swab' tas syal winhaj Pablo chi', xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Festo chi' t'a winh: --Tato icha chi', k'ik'anto tzab' tas syal winh, xchi winh t'a winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix k'och winhaj rey Agripa yet' ix Berenike chi'. Yelxo wal te wach' yilji heb' yet' spichul, ix och heb' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ix och pax heb' yajal soldado yet' heb' ichamtak winak t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Haxo winhaj Festo chi' ix chekan ik'jokkot winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach Rey Agripa yet' he masanil ix he molb'ej he b'a tik ket'ok, ina winhaj Pablo tik. Masanil heb' israel ix halan t'ayin to ay smul winh. Ix yal heb' t'ayin t'a Jerusalén, ix yalanpax heb' t'ayin t'a Cesarea tik to manhxo smojok pitzan winh.

Palta tzin na a in tik to malaj junok smul winh, yik smoj scham winh yuj. Toxo ix sk'anb'at sb'a winh t'a winh kajal Augusto, yik wach' a winh ol ch'olb'itan winh. Yuj chi' tzin na'a to ol wak'b'at winh.

Palta malaj tas wach' tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'a winh kajal chi' yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix wik'kot winh t'a ichanh ach rey Agripa yet' t'a eyichanh he masanil. Ha tiknaik, k'anb'ejek eyab' t'a winh, ta icha chi' ay junok smul winh tz'ilchaj eyuuj, yik a jun chi' ol in tz'ib'ejb'at t'a winh kajalil chi'.
¿Tom ol yal wak'anb'at junok presowum tato max in tz'ib'ejb'at smul tz'och t'a yib'anh? xchi winhaj Festo chi'.
Haxo winhaj rey Agripa chi' ix halan t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Syal halan tiknaik tas aji, xchi winh. Ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winhaj Pablo chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik:
--Ach rey Agripa, tzin te tzalaji yujto tzin a cha lolon t'a ichanh, yujto in gana swik'el jantaknhej tas ix yak'och heb' wetisraelal t'a wib'anh.
Te wach' swal t'ayach, yujto ojtaktaxon ko ley a onh israel onh tik. Ojtak pax tas tz'ik'an ko telan ko b'a. Yuj chi' tzin k'an t'ayach to niwan tzutej a k'ol t'ayin yik tzab'an tas ol wal t'ayach.
Ha heb' wetisraelal smasanil, yojtaktaxon heb' tas wutejnak in b'eyb'al t'a in chonhab' yet' t'a Jerusalén yiktax ix in kotoch uninal.
Tato ay snib'ej heb' syala', syal yalan heb' to ayxo tiempo fariseo in. Ha heb' fariseo chi' yelxo wal sk'anab'ajej juntzanh b'eyb'al yik ko k'ayb'ub'al heb'.
Haxo tiknaik, syak'och heb' t'a wib'anh yujnhej to swak'och yipok in k'ol tas yalnakkan Dios ayik yak'annakkan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ha heb' ketisraelal slajchawil makan, wan stanhwan heb' yelk'och tas yalnakkan Dios chi'. Yuj chi' k'ual t'ak'wal yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a Dios. Ach rey Agripa, yujnhej to tzin tanhwej yelk'och jun chi', yuj chi' syak'och heb' wetisraelal chi' t'a wib'anh tiknaik.
Ha exxo tik, ¿tas yuj max eyak'och t'a he k'ool to ha Dios tz'ak'an pitzwokxi heb' chamnak?
Ha in pensar t'a yalanhtaxo, to swak' chukal t'a heb' yik Jesús aj Nazaret. Ha in naani to te wach' swutej in b'a.
Icha chi' wutejnak in b'a t'a Jerusalén. Ochnak wopisio yuj heb' winh sat sakerdote, yuj chi' tzijtum heb' kreyente wak'nakoch t'a preso. Ayik smak'jicham heb', tzin tak'wib'at t'a spatik heb'.

Tzijtum el wak'nakoch syaelal heb' yik maxtzak yak'och Jesús heb' t'a sk'ool in naani. Icha chi' ek' wutejnak in b'a t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Te niwan chichonnak in k'ol t'a heb'. Xit'nak in pax ek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' te najat, xit' wak'annakoch syaelal heb'.
Yuj wal in chichonk'olal chi', a junel b'at in t'a chonhab' Damasco. Yujto ay wopisio yuj heb' winh sat sakerdote, yuj chi' schek in b'at heb' winh.

Palta ach rey swal t'ayach, tas aj in. Ayik wan in b'ey t'a chimk'ualil, wilan skot kopnaj jun sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh. Ek'alto yok t'a yok k'u. Emul kopnaj t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' ajun wet'ok.

Telwi onh t'a sat lu'um yuj jun sakil k'inal chi' ko masanil. Wab'an yawaj jun, yalan t'a ti' hebreo icha tik: Saulo, Saulo, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? Palta munil tzixtej a b'a icha junok nok' wakax stek'waj och t'a junok te te' stekjioch t'ay, xchi t'ayin.
Walan t'ay: Mamin, ¿mach ach? xin chi. Yuj chi', yalan Kajal Jesús t'ayin: Ha in ton tik, Jesús in. Ha in ton tzin ixtej.
Palta k'eanh waan. Tzul in ch'ox in b'a t'ayach yik ol ach och in chekab'ok, ol alanel yab'ixal tas ix il tik yet' jantaknhej tas toto ol in ch'ox ila'.
Ha tiknaik, tzach in chekb'at t'a heb' manh israelok. Ol ach in kolelta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' etisraelal.

Tzach in chekb'at t'a heb' yik wach' ol jawok spensar heb', yik syaktejkan jun sb'eyb'al heb' yik k'ik' k'inal, haxo yoch heb' t'a jun sakil k'inal yik Dios. Ol elkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh diablo, haxo t'a yol sk'ab' Dios ol ochkan heb'. Ol in yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool yik wach' ol ak'jokkan lajwok smul heb'. Ichato chi' ol och heb' yetb'eyumok heb' ayxo och yikok Dios, yujnhej in yak'anoch heb' t'a sk'ool, xchi Jesús t'ayin.
Yuj wal chi', ach rey Agripa, in k'anab'ajej tas ul yalkan Jesús chi' t'ayin, ayik skot t'a satcha'anh ul sch'oxan sb'a.

Yuj chi' ha t'a Damasco chi' in b'ab'laj alejel slolonel Dios. Slajwi chi' ek' walanel t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a masanil yol yik Judea, swalanpax t'a heb' manh israelok to sna sb'a heb', syak'anpaxoch spensar heb' t'a Dios. Swalan pax t'a heb' to yowalil wach' syutej sb'eyb'al heb', yik wach' scheklaji to yel sna sb'a heb'.
Yujto ix walel juntzanh chi', yuj chi' ix in syam heb' israel t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios. Ix yak'lan heb' in smilanchamok.

Palta ha Dios ix kolwaj wet'ok. Yuj chi' te tek'an ix wutej in b'a. Hanhejtona' pax tiknaik, tek'an swutej in b'a walanel slolonel Dios t'a masanil anima. Swal t'a heb' niwan yelk'ochi, swal pax t'a heb' malaj yelk'ochi. Ha heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yet' winhaj Moisés, ayokto stz'ib'annakkan heb' tastak ol jawok. Anhej juntzanh chi' tzek' waleli.

Swalaneli to a Cristo yowalil ix yab' syail, ix chami. Ixlajwi chi', haxo ix b'ab'laj pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak yik syalanel yab'ixal kolnab'il t'a heb' ketchonhab' yet' t'a heb' anima smasanil, xchi winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayik wan yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo chi', haxo winhaj Festo chi' ix k'e juknaj winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Pablo, tekan to ay tas tz'ixtan yol a jolom. Manh jantakok tas a k'ayb'ejnak, yuj chi' ha' ix k'e t'a a jolom, xchi winh t'a winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Pablo chi': --Ach wajalil Festo, malaj tas tz'ixtan yol in jolom. Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex, te yel, te niwan yelk'ochi.

Haxo winhaj rey Agripa tik, yojtaktaxon juntzanh tik winh sik'lab'il. Yuj chi', tek'an wal swutej in b'a walan juntzanh tik t'a yichanh winh. Ha juntzanh swal tik, manh k'ub'eltakok yaji, yojtaknhej heb' anima smasanil. Yuj chi' wojtak to yojtak pax winh rey tik.
Ha achxo tik ach rey Agripa, ¿tzam ak'och t'a a k'ool tas yalnakkan heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'? Wojtak to tzak'och t'a a k'ool, xchi winhaj Pablo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tom yujnhej jab' tzal tik tzin och kristianoal tza na'a? xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi': --Wach'chom yujnhej jab' ix wal tik t'ayach, mato yujto tzijtumto tas ol eyab'i, komonok tz'el t'a sk'ool Dios to icha ix in aj tik icha pax chi' tzach aj yet' jantak heb' ix ab'an tas ix wal tik, palta max ex tzek'chajlaj t'a k'een kadena icha waj tik, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winh, ix k'e linhan winh rey chi' yet' ix Berenike. Hanhejtona' ix k'epax linhan winhaj Festo yet' jantaknhej heb' ayek' chi' ta'.

Ix sb'esanel sb'a heb', yik smol alej heb' tas ol aj jun chi'. Ix yalan heb': --Manh smojok scham jun winh tik, yujto malaj jab'ok smul winh, hanhejtona' manh smojok ayoch winh t'a preso tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Agripa t'a winhaj Festo chi': --Syal kak'anel winh t'a libre tiknaik, ichokta' maj sk'anb'at sb'a winh t'a winh kajal t'a Roma chi', xchi winh.

Ix slajtian sb'a heb' winh yajal to sb'at winhaj Pablo t'a Roma t'a yol yik Italia. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji entregar winh yet' jaywanhxo heb' yetpresowumal t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh kapitán skuchan Julio. Ha jun winh chi', yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' jun makan heb' soldado winhaj Augusto.

Ix onh och t'a yol jun barko yik chonhab' Adramitio. Ha te' barko chi', t'inhan yek' te' t'a junjun lugar t'a stitak Asia. Ayik ix onh b'at t'a yol te', ix b'at pax winhaj Aristarco ket'ok, haton winh aj Tesalónica t'a yol yik Macedonia.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Sidón. Ha winhaj Julio chi', te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi', yuj chi' ix ak'ji spermiso winh yuj winh b'at sk'uman heb' swach'k'ool, yik syak' heb' tas yowalil tz'och yuj winh.
Ix onh elxi t'a Sidón chi', ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar. Ha t'a ko k'exanh ix kan Chipre chi' yujto manh tojolok sb'ey ik'.
Ix onh ek' t'a stitak Cilicia yet' t'a stitak Panfilia. Ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Mira, haton jun ay t'a yol yik Licia.
Haxo winh kapitán chi' ix sayanek' junxo te' barko ta'. Ix ilchaj jun te' barko yik Alejandría yuj winh wan sb'at t'a Italia. Yuj chi' t'a yol te' ix onh yak'xioch winh.

Ayik ix onh b'atxi te tzijtum k'ual ix onh b'eyi, yujto k'ojank'olal sb'ey te' barko chi'. Pural ix onh k'och t'a yichanhkot chonhab' Gnido. Ixlajwi chi', ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Salmón, ix onh ek' pax t'a Creta, haton jun ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, yujto a jun ik' chi' hanheja' manh tojolok sb'eyi.
Pural ix onh ek' t'a sti' Creta chi' masanto ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch “B'aj Wach' Tz'och waan Te' Barko” ay t'a slak'anil chonhab' Lasea.
Te ayxo smay sb'eyek' te' barko chi' t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi', yujto toxo ix te ek' tiempo, wanxo sja nhab'il k 'inal.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pablo t'a heb' icha tik: --Ex wetanimail, swila' to te ay smay ko b'at tiknaik. Ol lajwokel te' barko tik yet' yikatz smasanil. Hanhejtona' ay pax smay ol onh chamok, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Palta a winh kapitán chi', maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi'. Anhej tas ix yal winh tz'ik'an b'ey te' barko yet' winh aj barko chi' ix scha yab' winh.

Ha t'a jun lugar chi', malaj b'aj syal skan waan te' barko chi' yik tzek' nhab'il k 'inal chi'. Yuj chi' kenxonhej manh masanilok heb' ix naani to wach' tzonh b'atnhej, ta icha chi' kolan tzonh k'och t'a chonhab' Fenice t'a yol yik Creta chi'. Hata' snib'ej heb' ix ko tanhwej ek' nhab'il k 'inal chi', yujto manh owok sk'och ik' ta'.
Ix sna heb' to wach' tzonh b'ati, yujto ay jun ik' k'ojank'olal wan skot t'a sur. Yuj chi' ix onh b'ati. Ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil stitak Creta chi'.
Palta junanto rato chi' ix pitzwichaanh junxo niwan ik' tzek' t'a jun lu'um chi'.
Ix och chulan ik' t'a te' barko chi', majxo yal-laj sb'at te' b'aj sja ik' chi'. Yuj chi' ix kaktej kik'anb'at te' b'aj sja ik' chi', munilxonhej ix b'at te' b'aj sb'at ik' chi'.

Ix onh ek' t'a stz'ey jun yune' lugar skuch Clauda ay t'a snanhal ha' mar. Hata' manhxo owoklaj ik' icha ix aj sja t'a sb'ab'elal chi'. Aytaxon jun te' ko yune' barko tok'b'il yuj te' niwan chi'. Pural ix k'eta te' ko tok'an t'a yib'anh te' niwan chi'.

Ixlajwi sk'ek'och te' t'a yib'anh te' niwan chi', haxo heb' aj barko chi', ix sk'an juntzanh niwak lasu heb', yik stzek'an tzatzb'ok te' niwan chi' heb'. Yujto ix xiw heb' spok'anem sb'a te' t'a yib'anh jun yarenail jun skuchan Sirte, ay t'a sjayil sti' ha', yuj chi' ix stijemta juntzanh icha mantiado heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh te' barko chi', haton juntzanh smak'ji yuj ik'. Ixlajwi chi', ix onh kan ichnhej ta'. Munilxonhej ix onh yik'b'at te' yet' ik' chi'.
Hanhejtona' t'a junxo k'u, te ow jun ik' chi'. Yuj chi', ix och ijan heb' syumankanel yikatz te' t'a yol ha'.
Haxo t'a yoxil k'ual, ix onh kolwaj yet' heb' aj barko chi'. Ay pax juntzanh syamk'ab'il te' barko chi' ix ko yumkanel yet' heb'.
Niwan tiempo majxo kil-laj k'u yet' k'een k'anal. Haxo yuj jun ik' te ow ix k'och chi' t'ayonh, majxo ko nalaj tato tzato onh kolchaji.

Niwan tiempo majxo onh walaj. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e linhan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a ko kal. Ix yalan winh: --Ex wetanimail, oktom wal ix he cha eyab' tas ix wala'. Oktom maj onh kotlaj t'a Creta chi'. Tato icha chi', maj am ja jun tik t'a kib'anh, malaj am pax jab'ok tas ix sateli.
Haxo tiknaik swal t'ayex, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, yujto malaj junok onh ol onh chamok. Wach'chom ol lajwokel te' barko tik.
Yujto a q'uiq'ui t'ak'wal ix ul sch'ox sb'a jun yángel Dios t'ayin. Haton jun Dios b'aj swak' em in b'a, yujto ha' ay in yiko'.

Ix yalan jun ángel chi' t'ayin icha tik: Pablo, manh ach xiwok, yujto yowalil ol ach k'och t'a yichanh winh yajal t'a Roma. Uujnhej ol kolchajkanel heb' ayek' et' t'a yol te' barko tik yuj Dios, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi', tek'an tzeyutej he b'a ex wetanimail, yujto swak'och Dios yipok in k'ool to yowalil ol elk'och icha ix yal jun ángel chi' t'ayin.
Palta yowalil ol onh yumjokkanel t'a jun lum lum ay t'a snanhal ha', xchi winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi schanhlajunhil k'ual, hanheja' ay onh ek' t'a ha' mar yik Adria. Toxo ix onh k'axpajek' t'a jun ha' mar chi' yuj ik'. Haxo t'a chimilak'wal, a snaan heb' smunlaj t'a te' to wan ko k'och t'a junok lu'um.
Ix yechtan sjulal ha' heb'. Ay am junok 40 wara sjulal ha'. Ix b'at janik'xo te', ix yechtanxi heb', ayxonhej am junok 30 wara sjulal ha'.

Ix xiw heb' smak'an poj sb'a te' t'a k'een k'een ay t'a yich ha'. Yuj chi' ix yak'och t'unhan chanhe' k'een niwak k'een heb' t'a spatik elk'och te'. Haxo k'een ix yamanoch waan te'. Ixlajwi chi', ix stanhwan heb' sakb'i. Ix snib'ej heb' elanhchamel ix sakb'i.

Haxo heb' smunlaj t'a te' barko chi', ix snib'ej el sb'a heb' t'a elanhchamel. Yuj chi', k'ub'eltak ix yak'em t'unhunhok te yune' barko chi' heb' t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi'. Haxo ix yutej heb' yalani to a juntzanhxo k'een k'een ix yak'em heb' t'a snhi' te', yik malaj mach snaaneli tas wan sk'ulan heb'.
Palta haxo winhaj Pablo ix b'at halan t'a winh kapitán yet' t'a heb' soldado. --Tato tz'el heb' t'a yol te' barko tik, wal yel manh ol onh kolchajlaj, xchi winh.
Haxo heb' soldado chi' ix tzepan sch'anhal te' yune' barko chi'. Ix elkan t'inhnaj te' sch'okoj.
Haxo yik wan sakb'i, ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' smasanil to yowalil swa jab'ok heb'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Schanhlajunhilxo k'ual maxtzak ex wayi, maxtzak ex wa yuj xiwelal.
Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayex to tzex wa'i yik wach' ol ochxok eyip, yujto malaj junok onh ol onh chamok. Hanhejtona' malaj junok onh ol onh lajwok, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix yik'ankot jun pan winh. Ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'a Dios t'a yichanh heb' smasanil. Ix xepan snanhal ixim pan chi' winh. Ix syamanoch winh swaan ixim.
Ichato chi', ix sniwanan sb'a ko k'ool ko masanil. Ix onh waxi.
276 ko b'isul t'a yol te' barko chi'.
Ixlajwi ko waan tas icha ko gana, ix wach' yumchajkanb'at nanhalxo ixim trigo t'a yol ha' mar chi' yik sheb'b'i te' barko chi'.

Haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix yilanb'at lum lum heb' munlajwum t'a te' barko chi', palta manh yojtakok heb' b'ajtil ay jun lugar chi'. Ix yilanb'at jun sk'ab' ha' mar chi' heb', nab'a arena stitak. Ix snaan heb' to syak'lej heb' yik'anb'at te' barko chi' ta', talaj syal sk'och te' ta'.

Ix stzepan t'inhchaj sch'anhal k'een syamanoch waan te' barko chi' heb'. Ix kan juntzanh k'een k'een chi' t'a yol ha' mar chi'. Ix stijanel sch'anhal b'aj sch'umji te' heb', yik wach' syal sch'uman te' heb' junelxo. Ix yak'anxik'e jun icha mantiado heb' t'a chaanh, yik a smak'ji yuj ik' sb'eyxi te'. Yuj chi' ix och ijan te' sb'at b'aj ay yarenail sti' ha' chi'.

Palta ix spok'em sb'a te' t'a yib'anh k'een arena ay t'a yich ha'. Yuj chi' ix kan ch'apan te' t'a k'een arena chi'. Majxo ib'xoklaj jab'ok te'. Haxo te' spatik elk'ochi wan smak'jiel weknaj te' yuj yipal ha'.
Haxo heb' soldado, ix snib'ej heb' smilcham heb' preso yaji yik wach' malaj heb' tz'eli, sb'atkan heb' elelal.

Palta a winh kapitán chi' maj stak'laj winh smiljicham heb' presowum chi', yujto snib'ej winh skolkanel winhaj Pablo chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh to a heb' syal smak'an ha', syal sb'ab'laj b'at heb' t'a yib'anh ha', yik tz'elk'och heb' t'a sti' ha' b'aj ay lum lum.

Haxo heb' tzak'an sb'ati, ay heb' sb'at t'a yib'anh te' chemte'. Ay heb' sb'at t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo ste'al te' barko chi'. Icha chi' ix kutej ko b'a. Yuj chi' ix onh kolchajkanel ko masanil. Ix onh elkank'och t'a sti' ha' b'aj ay jun lum lum chi'.
Haxo yik ix onh kolchajkaneli ix kab'ani to a jun lum lum t'a snanhal ha' chi', Malta sb'i lu'um.
Haxo heb' aj chonhab' chi' te wach' ix yutej spensar heb' t'ayonh. Ix yak'anoch jun niwan k'ak' heb' yujto te siik, ay pax nhab'. Ix onh yawtanb'at heb' k'axnel.

Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix b'at mek'ankot juntzanhxo te' b'olob'. Ayik wan yak'anb'at te' winh t'a yib'anh k'ak', ay jun nok' chan ix elta t'a skal te' yuj te' k'ak' chi'. Ix chiji sk'ab' winh yuj nok', ix kan chinan nok' t'ay.

Ayik ix yilan heb' aj chonhab' chi' to ix kan chinan nok' t'a sk'ab' winh, ix yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, tekan mak'umcham anima winh. Wach'chom ix yak' ganar winh skolchaj t'a yib'anh ha' mar tik, palta yowalil ol scha spak smul winh chi', ol cham winh, xchi heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', tonhej ix stzikub'tanhej sk'ab' winh, ix em lanhnaj nok' t'a skal te' k'ak' chi'. Malaj jab'ok ix ik'an winh yuj nok'.

Haxo heb' smasanil, ix stanhwej heb' smal sk'ab' winh chi'. Ha snaan heb' to t'a jun rato chi' ol cham winh. Haxo ix yilan heb' ix ek' tiempo, malaj jab'ok tas ix ik'an winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'ex spensar heb'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Pablo tik, tekan Dios winh, xchi heb'.

Ha t'a slak'anil b'aj ay onh ek' chi', hata' ay sluum jun winh yajal yaj t'a Malta chi', haton jun winh skuch Publio. Ix onh schaoch winh t'a yol spat. Oxe' k'ual ix onh ek' yet' winh, te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'ayonh.

Palta a winh smam winhaj Publio chi', te penaay winh. Wan scham winh yuj k'ak'al yab'il yet' chik'. Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix och yet' winh t'a yol skuarto. Ix lesalwi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anek' sk'ab' winh t'a yib'anh winh. Ichato chi' ix b'oxikan sk'ool winh.
Ixnhej b'oxi sk'ool winh chi', a juntzanhxo heb' penaay t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix laj k'och heb' t'a winh. Ix b'oxipaxkan sk'ool heb'.
Te xajan ix onh yil heb' anima t'a jun lugar chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal ko b'atxi t'a yol junxo barko, ix laj yak' heb' tastak tz'och kuuj.

Oxe' ujal ix onh ek' t'a Malta chi'. Hata' waan och jun te' barko, wan stanhwan yek' nhab'il k 'inal te' ta'. Ha te' barko chi', yik chonhab' Alejandría te'. Ha t'a sat te' ayoch yechel chawanh sdiosal heb', haton Cástor yet' Pólux. Ha t'a yol te' ix onh ochi, ix onh b'ati.
Ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Siracusa. Haxo ta' ix onh wanaj oxe' k'ual.

Ixlajwi chi', ix onh b'atxi, ix onh ek' t'a slak'anil stitak lum lum, masanto ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Regio. Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix kot jun ik' t'a sur. Yuj chi' ix onh b'atxi, chab' k'ual ix onh b'eyxi t'a sat ha'. Ichato chi' ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Puteoli.
Hata' ix ilchajel jaywanh heb' kreyente kuuj. Ix yalan heb' to tzonh kan ukeok k'ual ta' yet' heb'. Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a kok ix onh b'at t'a chonhab' Roma.

Haxo heb' kreyente aj Roma chi', ayik ix yab'an heb' to wan ko k'ochi, ix ul onh scha heb' t'a b'e. Ay heb' ix ul onh chaan t'a Apio b'aj ay jun merkado, ay pax heb' t'a Oxe' Posado. Haxo ix yilanb'at winhaj Pablo chi' to wan sk'och heb' t'a winh, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'a Dios. Ix te tzalajk'e winh.

Haxo yik ix onh k'och t'a Roma chi' ix yak'anoch heb' presowum chi' winh kapitán t'a yol sk'ab' junxo winh yajal heb' soldado ayek' ta'. Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' maj ochlaj winh t'a preso yet' heb'. Tonhej ix kan winh t'a jun majan pat b'aj ix tanhwaj winh yuj jun winh soldado.

Schab'ilxo k'ual ko k'och ta', ix yawtankot heb' yichamtak winakil heb' israel aj Roma chi' winhaj Pablo chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a winh ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetchonhab', malaj jab'ok in mul t'a heb' ketisraelal. Maj in ju pax sb'eyb'al heb' ko mam kicham. Palta ha t'a Jerusalén in och t'a preso yuj heb', in yak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Roma.
Sk'anb'ej heb' aj Roma chi' t'ayin tas in mul. Palta ix yil heb' to malaj jab'ok in mul smoj in cham yuj. Yuj chi' ix snib'ej heb' in yak'el t'a libre.

Palta a heb' ketisraelal chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol heb' icha chi'. Yuj chi' ix in k'ankot in b'a t'a winh kajal t'a Roma tik, hato winh ol ch'olb'itanok tas in mul. Palta malaj jab'ok tas ol wak'b'at t'a yib'anh heb' ketchonhab' chi'.

Yuj chi' tzex wawtejkoti, yujto in gana tzex wila'', tzex in k'umej jab'ok. Yujto ay jun ko Kolumal tanhwab'iltaxon sjawi kuuj a onh israel onh tik. Yujnhej to swak'och in pensar t'a jun chi', ayoch k'een kadena tik t'ayin, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix yal heb' t'a winh: --Malaj junok karta ix kot t'a heb' aj Judea chi' b'aj syal uuj. Malaj pax junok heb' ketchonhab' israel ix ul halan junok tas t'a a patik.
Palta ko gana skab' a onh tik tas wan a naani. Yujto ix kab' spekal to ha t'a junjun lugar, slaj yal chukal heb' t'a spatik jun he k'ayb'ub'al toto pitzwinak chi', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an slajtial heb' tas k'ual smolb'ej sb'a heb' junelxo. Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi' tzijtum heb' ix smolb'ej sb'a b'aj ayek' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb' t'a q'uinhib'alil, masanto ix b'at k'u. Ix yalan wal winh t'a heb' sik'lab'il tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ix yawtan pax juntzanh tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ch'anh ley Moisés winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yik syak' winh yojtakejel heb' to yel tas syal winh yuj Jesús chi'.
Ay heb' ix ak'anoch t'a sk'ool. Ay pax heb' maj chaan yab'i tas ix yal winh.

Yujto maj scha sb'a spensar heb', ix laj pax heb' t'a spat. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb': --Ha Yespíritu Dios ak'annak yal winhaj Isaías t'a heb' ko mam kicham t'a peka'. Te yel jun yalnak winh chi', haton jun syal icha tik:
Ixik b'at al t'a heb' anima tik, tzalan icha tik: Wal yel ol eyab'i, palta manh ol nachajel-laj eyuuj. Wach'chom ol eyila', palta hanhejtona' manh ol nachajel-laj eyuuj, xa chi t'a heb'.

Yujto a heb' anima tik, toxo ix pitb'iel heb'. Icha to smak schikin heb', yik max yab' in lolonel heb'. Hanhejtona', icha to smutz' sat heb', yik max yil jun yel chi' heb'. Toxon max nachajel-laj jab'ok yuj heb'. Max sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb'. Max yak'och spensar heb' t'ayin, yik tzin kolan heb', xchi Yespíritu Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Yuj chi', nachajokab' el eyuuj to ha Dios wan yak'an jun kolnab'il tik t'a heb' manh israelok. Yujto a heb' chi' syak'och schikin heb' t'ay, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', chab' ab'il ix aj winh t'a yol jun smajan pat chi'. Haxo heb' ix laj k'och sk'umej winh ix chaji heb' yuj winh.
Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh yalaneli, chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ix yalanel juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Kajal Jesucristo winh. Malaj mach ix kachanoch waan jab'ok winh.
